  • Reportovať chyby a nedostatky, poskytovať rýchlu spätnú väzbu
  • Aktívne aplikovať princípy agilného testovania

A v rámci možností, prípadne neskôr, aj:

  • Vytvárať a udržiavať skripty pre automatizované testovanie
  • Proaktívne vyhľadávať a automatizovať opakujúce sa činnosti

Si ideálny kandidát ak máš:

  • Aspoň 2 roky praktických skúseností s testovaním softvéru (web aplikácie)
  • Anglický jazyk na úrovni B2
  • Skúsenosti s tvorbou testovacích scenárov a test dizajn technikami
  • Skúsenosti s automatizovaným testovaním (Playwright alebo Cypress a podobne)
  • Znalosť Windows a Linux
  • Skúsenosti s test manažment nástrojmi (JIRA, Zephyr atď.)
  • Znalosť a skúsenosť z procesu testovania v agilnom cykle vývoja

A veľkou výhodou ak máš:

  • Skúsenosti so skriptovacími jazykmi (Python, JavaScript/Typescript, PHP)
  • Skúsenosti s Git
  • Skúsenosť s nefunkcionálnym testovaním (performance) výhodou

Platové ohodnotenie (brutto): od 2300 EUR/m.

  • Finálna suma základnej zložky mzdy môže byť upravená v závislosti od individuálnych znalostí a skúseností vybraného kandidáta.

What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little More About The Team

You’ll join a high-performing, strategic sales team focused on moving Honeycomb further into the enterprise space. We’ve proven product-market fit, closed Fortune 500 logos, and built a pipeline that’s primed for the kind of enterprise sellers who know how to multi-thread, influence the C-suite, and navigate $500K–$1M+ ACV opportunities. This is not a role for a former mid-market rep trying to stretch—it’s built for enterprise closers who know the game and want to win it.

What You’ll Do In The Role

  • Own and drive complex, 6–12+ month sales cycles with Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies
  • Build strategic, multi-threaded relationships across engineering, DevOps, observability, and procurement leadership
  • Sell consultatively, bringing deep understanding of the customer’s business, technical landscape, and buying process
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Product, and Customer Success to shape high-value, tailored deals
  • Deliver predictable pipeline growth, accurate forecasting, and exceed quota targets
  • Represent Honeycomb at key industry events, conferences, and executive briefings

What You’ll Bring To The Role

  • 7+ years of full-cycle enterprise SaaS selling experience, ideally in DevOps, observability, or cloud infrastructure
  • Proven ability to land $500K+ multi-year deals with complex buying committees
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders across technical and non-technical roles
  • Deep discovery, storytelling, and consultative selling expertise
  • A track record of building champions and navigating enterprise buying cycles with precision
  • Grit, ambition, and a bias for execution—someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-ownership environments
  • Experience leveraging MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar enterprise sales frameworks

On Target Earnings (OTE) based on level of experience (Base + Commission)

€255.000 - €300.000 EUR

What You'll Get When You Join The Hive

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...

About Q:


The Apparel Industry Needs a Revolution. Be the Leader.


At SQ, we build on the quality and resourcefulness of our people, and we nurture a spirit of innovation. With wide-ranging roles involved in our apparel manufacturing business, we are keen to attract dynamic, talented, and motivated individuals, who are ready to contribute to the achievement of our goals.


Q Collection Pte Ltd, established in 1993 and headquartered in Singapore, is a leading apparel manufacturer with a proven track record of innovation and ethical practices. Operating under "SQ Group" in Bangladesh (https://www.linkedin.com/company/sq-group/), we’ve garnered recognition for our commitment to sustainable production processes and social responsibility. Q Collection actively seeks partnerships and investments aligned with our vision for a more sustainable future in the fashion industry. Our dedication to responsible manufacturing has positioned them as a trusted partner for major brands, solidifying our position as a front runner in the evolving landscape of apparel production.


Embark on a sustainable voyage with us; check out our Corporate Video: https://youtu.be/Uwr7GoyLH6o?si=sVbdmlp6QnNeUi.


Job Context:


The position is responsible to ensure that plant maintain a skilled workforce, maintain budgeted efficiency and minimize loss time.


Key Responsibilities:


Responsible for Overseeing Industrial Engineering Activities in the Product Development Stage

  • Assist the Product Development team in analysing and solving all technical aspects and provide inputs with respect to critical operations for new style.
  • Interface with multi-functional stakeholders at the Center and Plants to arrive at solutions which will yield the optimal SMV, for example, automation / outsourcing of certain activities.
  • Attend the sample review meetings and contribute with technical details of methods and costing.
  • Participate in discussions as required for finalization of style, for example, meetings with merchant and planning team, with relevant stakeholders from various functions.
  • Coordinate with bulk teams, share information with respect to the design intent and pass off, to enable them to plan and identify requirements in advance and discuss on bulk feasibility.
  • Ensure accurate calculations are shared with the concerned stakeholders on time, for example, with the design team during sample production and with Merchandising for costing purpose.


KPI / Measurement

  • Accuracy and on-time delivery.
  • Zero customer complaint.


Ensure Effective Communication of Technical Details of New Styles to Plant IE Teams, and Monitor the Achievement of Production Efficiencies

  • Coordinate with bulk teams, share information with respect to the design intent and pass off, to enable them to plan and identify requirements in advance and discuss on bulk feasibility.
  • Ensure all 5M’s and skill requirements for bulk production are identified and discussed in the pre production stage, for example, machine operator training needs assessment and hiring requirements.
  • Review complete OB/GSD file for all operations prepared by subordinates and share same to relevant Plant IE and ensure that the Plant IE has been provided all technical details and clarifications.
  • Coordinate with the Plant IE to ensure that the 1st 3-day efficiency ladder is achieved and in case of any delays, timely actions are taken to ensure achievement of the targeted efficiencies.
  • Provide advance communication to Plant IE teams on future styles / orders to enable them to plan resource and skill requirements and prepare budgets in advance.


KPI / Measurement

  • Plan vs. actual efficiency.


Responsible for Calculating SMV for Different Stages of Product Development and Costing Support

  • Prepare calculations of various productivity parameters, such as Standard Minute Value (SMV) using Data Bank/GSD and Standard Hours (SAH).
  • Carry out calculations at various stages of design finalization and pre-production, for example, different sample designs, adjustments based on availability of machine operators and machines, changes in fabric, etc.
  • Compare efficiency and identify workable options that are time and resource effective for the company.
  • Interface with multi-functional stakeholders at the Center and Plants to arrive at solutions which will yield the optimal SMV.
  • Share accurate calculations with the concerned stakeholders at various stages of design, pre production and bulk, as per guidelines and schedules.


KPI / Measurement

  • 5% saving from costed SMV.
  • 3% saving from loading SMV.


Key Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2-5year experience will give advantage.


Additional Requirements:


  • Needs to have in-depth knowledge on IE.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present findings.

job_summary: A McDonald’s Certified Swing Manager is a trained and certified leader responsible for overseeing daily restaurant operations during assigned shifts. This role ensures the restaurant operates safely, efficiently, and in full alignment with McDonald’s brand standards, with a strong focus on Quality, Service, and Cleanliness. The Certified Swing Manager leads the shift team by directing crew members, assigning positions, and managing floor operations to deliver an exceptional customer experience across all channels, including drive-thru, front counter, kiosk, mobile order, and curbside. They monitor speed of service, order accuracy, food quality, and hospitality to ensure every guest receives fast, friendly, and accurate service. This role is accountable for food safety and operational compliance. The Certified Swing Manager enforces food safety procedures, proper handwashing, time and temperature controls, equipment maintenance, and cleanliness standards throughout the restaurant. They conduct travel paths, ensure critical control points are being followed, and take immediate corrective action when standards are not met. Financial stewardship is also a key responsibility.   • Create training videos and documentation
  • Drive expansions and renewals
  • Define and build our customer success playbook as we scale

‍

What does a typical week look like?

This role flexes based on customer needs and product releases, but a typical week might look like:

  • 50% working directly with customers: onboarding, unblocking users, answering questions, improving outputs, running training sessions, and proactively reaching out when usage drops
  • 20% improving enablement: creating short videos, documentation, examples, and workflows so customers get value faster the next time
  • 15% working with product and engineering: reviewing customer feedback and helping prioritize fixes or improvements
  • 15% on reporting, analysis, and strategic projects: usage reviews, account health checks, and process improvements

‍

How technical is this role?

You'll work inside our product daily - learning the workflows, understanding how estimators use the tools, and diagnosing why outputs might not be meeting expectations. No coding required, but you should be comfortable becoming a power user and helping customers navigate the product confidently.

‍

‍

How we work?

We’re an AI-native company. Our team uses AI tools daily - for research, writing, analysis, and building. You should be comfortable working alongside AI and eager to find new ways to use it.

‍

‍

Who will I work with day to day?

You’ll report directly to our Founder & CEO Tristan Wilson and work closely with:

  • Our Chief Sales Officer, Alfredo Sanchez
  • Our Engineering Manager, Mauricio Piber
  • Our Founding Customer Success Manager, Tobin Saer

‍

What does success look like in the first 3–6 months?

  • 80%+ of customers actively using the product weekly and getting clear value
  • Gross revenue retention above 95%
  • Average first response time under 2 hours during business hours
  • Help close $100K+ in expansion revenue from existing customers
  • Generate 3+ customer referrals that result in closed deals
  • 20+ high-quality product insights documented and prioritized with the product team
  • 5+ pieces of enablement content created (videos, docs, workflows)
  • Issues and confusion are identified early and resolved quickly
  • Product and engineering have a clean, high-signal view of what customers actually need
  • Customers see you as the go-to person who “gets it” and gets things done

‍

Required

What We’re Looking For

  • High ownership, agency, urgency, and follow-through
  • Fast learner. No construction experience required, but you should be able to learn industry terms and answer questions from estimators and executives in 2-3 months
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Organized, proactive, and self-directed
  • High standards and attention to detail
  • Our customers start their day at 7:30am CST, so we typically start by 8am CST to be responsive
  • Willingness to travel ~1 week per month for customer visits and team collaboration

‍

Background

  • 3-6 years in one of these:
    • Construction roles with customer interaction (estimator, PM, field engineer, operations)
    • Customer-facing SaaS or solutions engineering
  • No CS experience required if you've worked in construction management - we care more about ownership, judgment, and how you work with customers than specific titles. Construction folks who've never done "customer success" are encouraged to apply
  • This role is about judgment, ownership, and learning speed
  • You should be able to point to examples where you've owned outcomes, worked directly with customers, and learned complex tools or processes quickly
‍

Why Join

  • You'll be joining at the right time. We've grown revenue 200%+ in the last 12 months and we're adding 5+ enterprise customers per month. We have real traction with top-tier contractors like CW Matthews and Barnhill, and we're seeing strong pull from infrastructure contractors of all sizes from coast to coast. The opportunity is massive and the timing is right. The next 12-18 months are when we scale from strong signal to category dominance.
  • You'll own a function, not just do a job. As our founding CSM, you'll build the playbook for how we scale to 100+ customers. If we nail this, in 12-18 months you could be leading a CS team, owning renewals/expansion revenue, or transitioning into product operations. Early hires define their own path here.
  • You'll work with an insider founder. Tristan is a fourth-generation contractor with 13 years in the field who's built a following of thousands of civil construction professionals through his newsletter. He knows this industry intimately and built a product contractors actually want (rare in construction tech). You'll learn from someone who understands both the problem and the solution.
  • You'll work with a team that's done this before. Our founding team has scaled startups past this stage. We're tight - we've been working together for years and know how to move fast and earn client trust. You're not joining a team figuring it out for the first time.
  • You'll see real impact fast. In construction, great customer success drives word-of-mouth referrals. Do this well and you'll directly see deals close because of your work. The feedback loop is immediate.
  • You'll get paid if we win. As a founding team member, your equity represents real upside if we execute. We're building infrastructure for a $12T industry that's ripe for disruption.

‍

Benefits

  • 15 days PTO (plus holidays)
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Unlimited book club budget

‍

About The Interview

We respond within 24 hours at every stage:

‍

Intro call (20min): a quick conversation with our CEO to see if there's mutual fit. We'll talk about your background and what you're looking for, and you can ask us anything about the role and company. This is just to make sure we're in the same ballpark before investing more time.

‍

Writing prompts (45min): two short scenarios for you to respond to in a Google Doc. One focuses on diagnosing why a customer's usage dropped and planning your next steps. The other tests how you'd prioritize competing feature requests from multiple customers. We're looking for clear thinking and judgment, not polish. Bullet points are fine.

‍

Background deep-dive (45min): we'll dig into your most relevant experience - the projects where you owned customer outcomes, the situations where things went sideways, and how you approach learning new things. Our goal is to understand what you've actually done and whether you can handle what this role requires. We'll save time to answer any questions you have about Edgevanta.

‍

Mock customer call (30min): you'll run a mock onboarding or check-in call with our CEO and a founding team member, who will play a customer. The twist: you pick the product - anything you know well enough to walk someone through. Could be a SaaS tool, a construction software, whatever. We want to see your natural customer interaction style, not how well you can cram on Edgevanta in 24 hours. We'll send you a scenario a day before.

‍

Nashville visit (half-day): for finalists, we'll bring you to Nashville to meet the founding team at The Malin in Wedgewood-Houston. You'll spend a few hours with us and get a feel for how we work. We cover all costs. This is as much for you to evaluate us as it is for us to meet you in person.

‍

Throughout this, we're asking ourselves: would we trust this person to own our customer relationships when things get hard?

  • Why Edgevanta? What about this role and problem space is interesting to you and how does it fit into your career goals?

Notre institut réunit 15 000 chercheurs, ingénieurs, techniciens et personnels administratifs, avec un objectif commun : améliorer la santé de tous par le progrès des connaissances sur le vivant et sur les maladies, l’innovation dans les traitements et la recherche en santé publique. Rejoindre l’Inserm, c’est intégrer un institut engagé pour la parité et l’égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l’accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l’Inserm mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. L'Inserm a reçu en 2016 le label européen HR Excellence in Research et s'est engagé à faire évoluer ses pratiques de recrutement et d'évaluation des chercheurs. Le Poste L'accident vasculaire cérébral (AVC) ischémique aigu lié à l'occlusion d'une grosse artère est une cause majeure de handicap et de décès. Bien qu'une reperfusion endovasculaire puisse réalisée avec succès dans plus de 90 % des cas, une grande partie des vaisseaux recanalisés peuvent présenter des lésions cérébrales importantes dues à des complications suite à la reperfusion (c-IRI) comme l’hypoperfusion persistante, la transformation hémorragique ou l’œdème, ce qui peut entraver le rétablissement du patient. De nombreux facteurs cliniques, radiologiques et biologiques ont été associés à la survenue de c-IRI. Cependant, il n’existe pas encore de modèle prédictif fiable pour guider la prise en charge de ces patients. job_summary: Position Summary The Sterile Processing Technician is responsible for the decontamination, inspection, assembly, sterilization, and distribution of surgical instruments and equipment to support safe patient care in an outpatient surgical center. This role ensures that all surgical instruments and supplies are processed according to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and facility policies to maintain a sterile and safe environment for surgical procedures. The technician works closely with clinical and operating room staff to ensure timely instrument availability and compliance with infection control and sterilization standards. Key Responsibilities Instrument Reprocessing and Sterilization: Receive, sort, and decontaminate surgical instruments, equipment, and trays following established infection prevention protocols. Inspect instruments for cleanliness, functionality, and damage; identify items requiring repair or replacement. Assemble instrument trays and surgical sets accurately in accordance with count sheets and surgeon preference cards. Operate and monitor washers, ultrasonic cleaners, autoclaves, and other sterilization equipment. Select appropriate sterilization methods (steam, low-temperature, or chemical) based on equipment specifications and manufacturer guidelines. Maintain accurate sterilization records, logs, and documentation to ensure traceability and regulatory compliance. Inventory, Storage, And Distribution Maintain adequate inventory levels of sterile supplies, surgical instruments, and disposable materials. Ensure sterile storage areas remain clean, organized, and protected from contamination. Deliver sterile trays, case carts, and surgical supplies to designated clinical areas in a timely manner. Rotate stock appropriately to prevent expiration and ensure readiness for surgical cases. Compliance, Safety, And Quality Control Adhere to regulatory, accreditation, and safety standards including AAMI, AORN, OSHA, CDC, and The Joint Commission guidelines. Participate in routine audits, biological testing, and equipment monitoring to verify sterilization effectiveness. Follow infection control procedures to maintain a clean and safe work environment. Participate in continuing education, in-service training, and quality improvement initiatives as required. Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Completion of a Sterile Processing / Central Service Technician training program preferred. Current certification as a Certified Registered Central Service Technician (CRCST), Certified Sterile Processing and Distribution Technician (CSPDT), or Certified Board for Sterile Processing and Distribution (CBSPD). Minimum one (1) year of sterile processing experience, preferably in an ambulatory surgery center, outpatient clinic, or hospital setting. Experience using electronic instrument tracking systems preferred. Skills And Competencies Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high levels of accuracy. Position Summary

The Sterile Processing Technician is responsible for the decontamination, inspection, assembly, sterilization, and distribution of surgical instruments and equipment to support safe patient care in an outpatient surgical center.

This role ensures that all surgical instruments and supplies are processed according to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and facility policies to maintain a sterile and safe environment for surgical procedures.

The technician works closely with clinical and operating room staff to ensure timely instrument availability and compliance with infection control and sterilization standards.

Key Responsibilities

Instrument Reprocessing and Sterilization:

  • Receive, sort, and decontaminate surgical instruments, equipment, and trays following established infection prevention protocols.
  • Inspect instruments for cleanliness, functionality, and damage; identify items requiring repair or replacement.
  • Assemble instrument trays and surgical sets accurately in accordance with count sheets and surgeon preference cards.
  • Operate and monitor washers, ultrasonic cleaners, autoclaves, and other sterilization equipment.
  • Select appropriate sterilization methods (steam, low-temperature, or chemical) based on equipment specifications and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate sterilization records, logs, and documentation to ensure traceability and regulatory compliance.

Inventory, Storage, And Distribution

  • Maintain adequate inventory levels of sterile supplies, surgical instruments, and disposable materials.
  • Ensure sterile storage areas remain clean, organized, and protected from contamination.
  • Deliver sterile trays, case carts, and surgical supplies to designated clinical areas in a timely manner.

job_description_formatted:
About VeUP

VeUP is a boutique AWS consulting and ISV enablement partner built for people who'd rather move fast and own outcomes than sit in someone else's org chart. We live at the intersection of consulting delivery and partner-led growth, deep AWS relationships, real technical chops, and a team small enough that your work actually moves the needle. No bureaucracy, no red tape, no "that's not my job."


The Role

We're hiring an Account Executive to run a territory like it's your own business. You'll drive revenue through AWS co-sell, direct prospecting, and partner-sourced pipeline, and you'll do it shoulder-to-shoulder with our Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Alliance Director, and Marketing teams, not in a silo. You own the cycle start to finish.


If you already speak fluent AWS-partner and you're tired of slow-moving orgs that reward tenure over hustle, this is your next move.


What You'll Do

●       Own a territory end-to-end — pipeline, forecast, close, expand

●       Build and work an active bench of AWS AEs and technical leaders, using AWS Marketplace and co-sell tools like they're second nature

●       Pitch and close VeUP's Ignite, Build, and Sell programs across AI/ML, data, and beyond — adapting your play for SMBs, startups, and ISVs

●       Structure deals using AWS resell models — PPA, EDP, committed resell — without needing a refresher

●       Turn AWS-sourced leads, assessments and Well-Architected Reviews into signed revenue

●       Team up with our Principal SA to scope and position deals that actually get delivered well

●       Keep Salesforce clean and your forecast honest — no vibes-based pipeline

●       Work with CS so handoffs are smooth and accounts don't churn

●       Show up in AWS offices, customer rooms, and partner events as a rep of the brand


What You Bring

●       You close deals

●       5-8 years crushing full-cycle cloud sales or partner-driven roles in the AWS ecosystem — bonus points for time on the AWS field side or running large enterprise IT deals

●       You know APN tiers and incentive structures cold, and you've actually sold PPA, EDP, and committed resell — not just heard of them

●       A real Rolodex of AWS AMs and technical leaders you can activate, not just LinkedIn connections

●       Reps selling to SMBs, startups, and ISVs, and you know these buyers are not the same animal as enterprise

●       SaaS chops or GenAI fluency — a big plus, not a dealbreaker

●       You run discovery like a pro — find the real pain, not the surface-level ask

●       Comfortable owning a number and forecasting it honestly, not padding it to look good

●       Based in a US field territory


Who You Are

Command of the room. Naturally curious. Sharp on details. You say what you mean and skip the filler. You take ownership without being chased, and you're fine operating without a perfect playbook, a full headcount, or a finished process — because that's the job at a company this size.

Straight up, this is startup life:

●       Good enough is great - ship it, then iterate

●       Ambiguity doesn't rattle you

●       Titles are for customers - zero power trips, zero micromanaging

●       Big-picture thinker and operator - you can zoom out and still get your hands dirty

●       Energetic and confident, but with the emotional intelligence to read a room and stay patient when it counts

●       You do what it takes, and you're actually good to work with


Compensation & Structure

250-330k$ OTE, base + variable, with real accelerators tied to co-sell-sourced revenue Salary and full commission structure on the table during the interview process.


Why VeUP

●       Small, senior team — your wins are visible, not buried in a pipeline report nobody reads

●       AWS relationships are already warm — you're not cold-starting a co-sell motion from zero

●       You'll shape how we sell, not just execute someone else's playbook

VeUP is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

 JOB DESCRIPTION

An Experienced Manager in BDO’s Partnerships group, is responsible for advising clients on the tax implications of their business objectives and various partnership specific items including but not limited to section 704(b) and taxable income allocations, capital account maintenance, liability analysis and allocations, section 734(b) and 743(b) adjustment calculations and Tax Receivable Agreement (TRA) calculations. Tax Specialization

Research

Ta chansen, sök redan idag! Om tjänsten Vår kund är ett etablerat IT-företag som erbjuder specialistkompetens inom infrastruktur, systemutveckling, hosting och helhetskoncept för IT-drift. Bolaget kombinerar den nära och personliga känslan i ett mindre företag med möjligheten att arbeta i stora, tekniskt avancerade kundmiljöer. Här erbjuds goda personalförmåner, stark gemenskap och regelbundna sociala aktiviteter. Genomföra säkerhetsgranskningar samt implementera skyddsåtgärder för att stärka infrastrukturen. Noggrant dokumentera och rapportera nätverkskonfigurationer och förändringar. Vi söker dig som har Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom IT, nätverk eller säkerhet, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Minst två års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som nätverkstekniker. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av Cisco och F5, samt kunskap inom nätverksinfrastruktur, IT-säkerhet och Windows (server/klient). Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Tjänsten kan kräva godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt gällande bestämmelser (vilket i vissa fall innebär krav på visst medborgarskap). För att lyckas i rollen krävs ett starkt tekniskt intresse och en vilja att hålla sig uppdaterad med branschens utveckling. job_summary: Job Summary The Head of External Communications & Reputation serves as the enterprise leader responsible for protecting and advancing Kaiser Permanentes reputation, shaping external narratives, leading enterprise issues and crisis response, elevating thought leadership, and strengthening the organizations visibility and influence across key stakeholders. Reporting directly to the Chief Public Affairs Officer and serving as a member of the Chief Public Affairs leadership table, this executive plays an enterprise-wide leadership role and provides strategic direction for reputation management, issues and crisis communications, labor communications, media relations, public relations, social media, enterprise newsroom strategy, thought leadership amplification, and enterprise communications campaigns. The Head of External Communications & Reputation serves as one of Kaiser Permanentes most senior communications advisors, providing counsel to executive leadership on issues with significant reputational, operational, political, labor, regulatory, and stakeholder implications. This leader is expected to exercise exceptional judgment in ambiguous, high-stakes situations where decisions may have enterprise-wide impact. As the enterprise leader for external communications and reputation management, this executive establishes strategy, governance, standards, operating models, priorities, and capabilities that enable a coordinated One KP approach to reputation management, media engagement, issues response, and external storytelling. While Market Public Affairs Leaders are responsible for communications execution within their respective markets, this role provides enterprise leadership and strategic direction across the communications function. Job Description

About the Role

The Network for AI (NFAI) Inside Sales Specialist is responsible for driving data center networking and routing solution opportunities across commercial and lower-tier enterprise accounts through a virtual-first engagement model.

This role serves as the inside counterpart to field-led enterprise specialist coverage, owning a defined segment of accounts where opportunities may involve meaningful technical complexity, multi-stakeholder buying processes, and executive alignment. In addition to sales responsibilities, the role acts as a subject matter expert (SME) for the NFAI portfolio, providing solution design guidance and architectural perspective to Account Managers and Sales Engineers.

Success in this role requires a seller who can balance the efficiency of an inside model with the technical depth required to design credible architectures, guide solution direction, and support account teams in positioning HPE Networking technologies effectively. The role frequently partners with Account Managers, Sales Engineers, partners, and field specialists to develop pipeline, shape opportunities, and deliver technically sound networking solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Opportunity Development

  • Drive pipeline development and revenue growth for HPE Networking’s data center networking, routing, and AI infrastructure connectivity portfolio across assigned commercial and lower-tier enterprise accounts.
  • Lead consultative discovery conversations to understand customer business objectives, infrastructure requirements, and modernization initiatives.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures in collaboration with Sales Engineers, recommending appropriate designs, deployment models, and phased adoption strategies.
  • Provide architectural guidance during early opportunity stages, helping customers and internal teams evaluate topology options, fabric architectures, scalability considerations, and integration points.
  • Progress opportunities using structured sales methodologies (such as MEDDPICC), ensuring alignment around decision criteria, business value, and stakeholder sponsorship.
  • Build and communicate compelling business cases that connect networking modernization initiatives to measurable business outcomes such as scalability, performance, resilience, operational efficiency, and cost optimization.

Customer & Executive Engagement

  • Establish trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders including network architects, IT managers, infrastructure leaders, and operations teams.
  • Engage confidently with director-, VP-, and selected C-level stakeholders when executive sponsorship is required to advance an opportunity.
  • Navigate complex buying committees and align internal and external stakeholders around architecture direction and investment rationale.

Technical Leadership & SME Support

  • Act as a subject matter expert for the NFAI portfolio, supporting Account Managers and Sales Engineers with technical positioning, solution architecture guidance, and competitive differentiation.
  • Assist account teams in designing networking solutions that align with validated architectures, customer requirements, and HPE Networking best practices.
  • Provide architectural input during account strategy development, helping teams identify modernization opportunities and expansion paths.
  • Support technical discussions such as solution topology, scalability planning, integration with compute/storage platforms, and AI infrastructure connectivity requirements.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineers on detailed solution validation while maintaining ownership of overall solution strategy and value articulation.

Partner & Internal Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Account Managers, Sales Engineers, channel partners, and field specialists to advance complex opportunities and ensure coordinated pursuit strategies.
  • Qualify when to lead independently versus when to engage additional technical, executive, or specialist resources based on opportunity complexity and account dynamics.
  • Leverage partner ecosystems to expand reach, accelerate solution adoption, and support joint account strategies.

Pipeline & Forecast Discipline

  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility, forecasting, and opportunity hygiene within Salesforce and associated sales tools.
  • Apply disciplined opportunity qualification and prioritization to ensure efficient use of time and resources across a higher-volume inside sales environment.

Portfolio & Market Expertise

  • Maintain deep working knowledge of HPE Networking’s data center switching, routing, AI networking, and fabric architectures.
  • Understand how networking infrastructure integrates with compute, storage, and AI workloads within modern data center and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Stay current on validated designs, architectural best practices, and evolving networking technologies relevant to AI and data center modernization.
  • Maintain awareness of competitive networking technologies to articulate architectural differentiation and displacement strategies.

Scope & Complexity

  • Owns a defined set of commercial and lower-tier enterprise accounts, typically domestic or regional in scope.
  • Opportunities may range from incremental infrastructure expansion to competitive replacements and architectural modernization initiatives.
  • Handles a higher volume of opportunities than field-led specialist roles while still navigating meaningful technical complexity and multi-stakeholder buying environments.
  • Frequently supports account teams as an architectural SME while advancing sales pursuits through an inside engagement model.

Education & Experience

  • 6–8+ years of experience in networking technology sales, specialist sales, or hybrid technical-commercial roles.
  • Proven success selling and positioning networking infrastructure solutions within commercial and/or enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate in or lead solution architecture discussions related to switching, routing, and data center networking.
  • Experience collaborating with Sales Engineers on solution design and technical validation.
  • Candidates with slightly less experience must demonstrate exceptional technical credibility, executive communication skills, and a track record of supporting complex infrastructure solutions.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of data center networking architectures including leaf-spine designs, fabric architectures, and scalable routing solutions.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into credible solution designs and architectural approaches.
  • Capability to provide SME support to account teams by guiding solution positioning, architecture decisions, and technical strategy.
  • Strong executive communication skills and ability to build credibility with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • High level of sales discipline, forecasting accuracy, and opportunity management rigor.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced inside sales environment that requires balancing technical engagement with opportunity volume.

Participate in and facilitate resident and community meetings and drop-in sessions to discuss the relocation process and resident relocation rights and benefits. Prepare and distribute appropriate notices to affected households regarding the relocation program and ensure proof of resident receipt for notices are received and on file as required. Job title: Director Global Market Access & Pricing, frexalimab

  • Location: Cambridge, MA

About The Role

Frexalimab is a potential first-in-class anti-CD40L antibody that could change the course of MS by addressing remaining unmet need. With compelling Phase 2 efficacy data and a comprehensive Phase 3 program underway, including 3 clinical studies for RMS and nrSPMS, the program is at a critical point. MS is expected to be the first indication in a broader multi-indication program spanning immunology and metabolic diseases.

The frexalimab Global Market Access & Pricing director role provides an exceptional opportunity to make a tangible difference in patients' lives by contributing to the pricing and market access strategy across RMS and nrSPMS indications and supporting its end-to-end execution. The stakes for this role are high. In a highly competitive MS landscape, frexalimab's ambition to redefine the standard of care demands novel approaches and best-in-class methodologies to unlock its full pricing and access potential in RMS and nrSPMS. Critically, while this role focuses on MS, the strategic choices made now in MS will set the tone and trajectory for potential follow-on indications, amplifying the long-term impact of this role well beyond the initial launch.

This is a highly collaborative role, requiring strong cross-functional partnership with Commercial, Medical, Clinical, Evidence for Access, Global Pricing, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Public Affairs teams, as well as country teams. You'll be part of a high-performing team that values strategic thinking and an unwavering focus on patient access.

This position sits within the Global Market Access & Pricing Neurology Team, which is part of the Specialty Care Global Market Access organization, where collaboration, patient-centricity, and scientific rigor drive everything we do. Our mission is to enable timely access for patients while securing value recognition by external stakeholders, including payers.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system - and innovative pipeline - enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Drive development of key pricing & market access deliverables, including the market access plan, payer value story, global pricing policy informed by pricing research and other data points, contracting strategy, country launch sequencing, negotiation guide, and objection handler
  • Play a key role in shaping the MS ecosystem in collaboration with Commercial, Medical, Public Affairs, other global business partners and countries to drive payer value recognition of frexalimab by the time of launch, aiming for sustainable access to innovation
  • Generate actionable payer insights through primary research, payer advisory boards, or other platforms to continuously pressure test and refine frexalimab's value proposition and ensure pricing and access strategies are grounded in robust market understanding across markets
  • Contribute to the development of frexalimab’s pricing and access MS strategy and scenario planning, in partnership with the Global Brand / Global Project Teams and countries, taking a holistic approach to optimize brand value
  • Champion the adoption of digital and AI-enabled tools within the payer access strategy and execution for frexalimab, partnering with relevant internal stakeholders to identify opportunities that enhance payer engagement, value messaging, and decision-making support
  • Ensure relevant input and engagement from countries, partnering closely with country Market Access leads to co-develop global deliverables optimally and on time to support local payer negotiations
  • Work with Evidence for Access, Medical, and relevant functions to secure evidence generation plans, prioritization, and deliverables that robustly support access and pricing objectives
  • Maintain deep knowledge of the MS and payer ecosystems – scientific/clinical developments, competitive landscape, payer dynamics, and healthcare policy changes – to proactively identify market access opportunities and threats and inform frexalimab’s market access and pricing strategy.

About You

  • Bachelors degree minimum, advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum 7 years of pharmaceutical/biotech industry experience, with an accomplished track record in pricing and market access, preferably in multiple sclerosis, neurology, or similar complex therapeutic areas
  • Experience working across different payer archetypes, with deep knowledge of the US market and healthcare system
  • Innovative mindset with ability to develop creative solutions to complex problems
  • Proven track record of developing and executing payer shaping initiatives in challenging reimbursement environments
  • Strong analytical skills, including pricing expertise, with ability to translate clinical information and messages into clear payer access strategies and recommendations
  • Flexibility and demonstrated ability to work across multiple projects and priorities
  • Demonstrated relationship building at all levels of the organization and across geographies; experience working collaboratively and cross-functionally
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear and concise messages based on complex information
  • Strong business acumen, analytical and financial skills to evaluate investment strategies; comfortable with product forecast and P&L
  • Fluent in English, both written and oral

Why Choose Us

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

The plan of care provides direction for the patient/family/significant other and interdisciplinary team. * Intervention - the specific interventions or orders that are implemented consistent with the plan of care and medical treatment plan. * Evaluation - a step in the process that involves determining the effectiveness of the interventions in achieving the plan of care and determining the conclusions concerning the achievement or lack of achievement of desired outcomes. job_summary: Wat ga je doen? Als analist ben je werkzaam op twee verschillende terreinen. Aan de ene kant kun je gevraagd worden om een veiligheidsbeeld op te stellen en trends te analyseren (veiligheidsanalyse). Aan de andere kant kun je ingezet worden om binnen complexe opsporingsonderzoeken) hypotheses en scenario’s op te stellen en te analyseren (zaaksanalyse). Het maken van dreigingsinschattingen, het vormen en toetsen van scenario’s of het vervullen van een ondersteuningsrol in een Staf Grootschalig Bijzonder Optreden (SGBO) kan onderdeel worden van je takenpakket. Veiligheidsanalist Als veiligheidsanalist stel je analyses op die gebaseerd zijn op een analysevraag vanuit de geprioriteerde thema’s, bijvoorbeeld de duiding van cruciale rollen van subjecten binnen een crimineel samenwerkingsverband. Jouw analyses kunnen ook ongevraagd tot stand komen als gevolg van een door jou gesignaleerd veiligheidsprobleem, fenomeen of trend. Je onderzoekt en analyseert de beschikbare data in samenhang en duidt deze naar ernst, aard en omvang. Hiervoor gebruik je jouw kennis van methoden en technieken. De analyses zet je om in concrete interventieadviezen ter ondersteuning van de sturing op (integrale) veiligheidsvraagstukken. Een advies kan bijvoorbeeld gericht zijn op de aanpak van subjecten of het prioriteren van thema’s zoals bijvoorbeeld migratie, milieu, cybercrime en ondermijning. Jouw adviezen zijn erop gericht om de politie de meest optimale keuzes te laten maken op basis van de beschikbare informatie. Zaaksanalist Als zaaksanalist word je ingezet bij grootschalige opsporingsonderzoeken, waarbij je bijdraagt aan de hoofdvraag ‘wat is er gebeurd’. Dit gaat samen met het opbouwen van onze algehele informatiepositie. Je voorkomt tunnelvisie. Dit doe je onder andere door het reconstrueren van het meest aannemelijke scenario en het in beeld brengen van eventuele alternatieve scenario’s. Je analytische vaardigheden en creativiteit komen daar goed bij van pas. Je komt in aanraking met de meest uiteenlopende zware delicten en staat midden in de dynamiek van de opsporing en intelligence. Je bent dus een belangrijke schakel in de optimale werking van opsporingsonderzoeken en de intelligence. Werken buiten reguliere kantoortijden en beschikbaar zijn tijdens weekend- en feestdagen is daarbij nodig. Dit kan zijn in een opsporingsonderzoek, voor het maken van een dreigingsinschatting of als operationeel ondersteuner binnen een SGBO. Hiervoor is een consignatieregeling van toepassing. Er wordt dan van je verwacht dat je binnen afzienbare tijd aanwezig bent op de werklocatie. Waar ga je werken? De DRIO Oost-Brabant is een dynamische dienst die bestaat uit meer dan 200 medewerkers die 24/7 de politieorganisatie en haar partners voorziet van actuele intelligence. Binnen de verschillende afdelingen van de DRIO werken medewerkers dagelijks met intelligence uit onder andere onze politiesystemen, open bronnen en op basis van menselijke bronnen. Je collega’s van de DRIO werken fysiek centraal samen in Eindhoven en sluiten daarnaast decentraal aan op meerdere plekken in de eenheid, dicht bij de operationele processen van opsporing, handhaving en beleidsvorming. De werkcultuur is open, inhoudelijk kritisch en ontwikkelgericht. De Eenheid Oost-Brabant kenmerkt zich door de Brainport-regio met een sterke focus op hightech en design. Integrale samenwerking in de aanpak van onder andere ondermijning is ook kenmerkend voor onze eenheid. Deze regionale context is van grote betekenis voor de ontwikkelrichting van de DRIO. Wie ben jij? Je bent maatschappelijk breed georiënteerd en volgt ontwikkelingen in de samenleving op de voet. Daarnaast ben je nieuwsgierig en analytisch ijzersterk. Binnen je vakgebied en specialisme weet je constructief met collega’s samen te werken en ben je een volwaardige sparringpartner. Daarnaast denk jij met frisse ideeën ‘outside the box’. Jij bent initiatiefrijk en gericht op vernieuwing. Je streeft ernaar om de DRIO nog beter en slimmer te maken. Met veel energie, creativiteit en flexibiliteit zet jij je dagelijks in om veiligheidsproblemen inzichtelijk te maken, om bij te dragen aan opsporingsonderzoeken en om de beste producten en resultaten na te streven met je collega’s. De veranderende maatschappij en de beweging in de DRIO vragen een actieve leerhouding en de bereidheid om te veranderen. Je kunt snel schakelen tussen het maken van analyses of informatierapporten tot aan behoeften concretiseren met collega’s en het geven van presentaties. Ook heb je een goed ontwikkeld gevoel voor verschillende belangen en beschik je over een gezonde dosis organisatiesensitiviteit. Je communicatieve vaardigheden heb je sterk ontwikkeld en je legt gemakkelijk contacten. Je neemt zelf initiatief en kunt je werk goed organiseren en structureren. Verder Vragen Wij hbo-diploma (bachelor) werk- en denkniveau*; affiniteit en ervaring met het verwerken en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden (ongestructureerde) data en ervaring met data-analysesystemen; affiniteit met digitalisering, omdat dit kansen met zich meebrengt om ons helpen en om de informatiepositie te verbeteren; bij voorkeur ervaring met diverse systemen (iBase, Analyst’s Notebook, Mercure) en het gebruik van Summ-IT als bronsysteem; ervaring met het professioneel presenteren van bevindingen; affiniteit met het intelligence- en opsporingsvakgebied. Wat wij bieden De standplaats is Eindhoven/Den Bosch. Er is ruimte voor 2 fte. Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week. Wij bieden je een geweldige baan waarin je uitgedaagd wordt om een bijdrage te leveren aan het oppakken van veiligheidsproblematieken. Afhankelijk van je achtergrond volg je aan de Politieacademie een 14-weekse opleiding voor specifieke inzetbaarheid (36 uur per week), met eventueel aansluitend een voor de functie benodigd aanvullend opleidingsprogramma. Tijdens deze opleiding(en) ontvang je al het met jou overeengekomen salaris. Het positief afronden van het verplichte assessment is voorwaarde om aan de opleiding te kunnen beginnen. Het behalen van de opleiding is een vereiste om deze functie uit te kunnen oefenen. Hier vind je alle informatie met betrekking tot de selectieprocedure, het assessment en de opleiding. Tijdens de interne specifieke politieopleiding word je tijdelijk aangesteld als ambtenaar in opleiding. Na het voltooien van de opleiding bieden we je een tijdelijke aanstelling aan, waarbij een proeftijd van één jaar van toepassing is. Na deze proeftijd volgt zo snel mogelijk een vaste aanstelling. Binnen de politie investeren we in jouw toekomst. We bieden uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een aantrekkelijk pakket arbeidsvoorwaarden. Denk hierbij aan: een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 3.363,- en maximaal € 5.418,- (schaal 9 Bbp) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek; een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) dat uit twee delen bestaat: Een bruto deel van 17,86% van je salaris. Met dit budget kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het uitbetalen van je budget, het kopen van vakantie-uren of ontwikkelactiviteiten zoals een opleiding. Een netto deel van € 515,91 per jaar. Dit budget kun je bijvoorbeeld gebruiken voor duurzaamheidsdoelen, vakbondscontributie, vitaliteit of het aflossen van je studieschuld bij DUO. een uitstekende pensioenopbouw bij ABP en betaald ouderschapsverlof (meer info over verlof, regelingen en mogelijkheden). De formele functie binnen het functiegebouw van de politie is operationeel specialist A. Interesse? Bel of mail met Janneke van Noord, teamchef (06 - 25 03 07 88, janneke.van.noord@politie.nl) als je meer informatie over de functie wilt hebben. Voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure bel of mail je met Eline van den Brand, recruiter (06 – 18 18 60 69, eline.van.den.brand@politie.nl). Solliciteer uiterlijk 22 september 2026 via de sollicitatiebutton. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wat verder belangrijk is Een betrouwbaarheids- en omgevingsonderzoek en mogelijk een assessment maken deel uit van de selectieprocedure. Je hebt de Nederlandse nationaliteit (dit mag ook je tweede nationaliteit zijn). De politie werkt in een veranderende samenleving waarin uiteenlopende perspectieven essentieel zijn voor goed politiewerk. Daarom is diversiteit voor ons van groot belang. job_summary: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. This position is opened for internal staff only Job Overview Under the technical supervision of the Legal Affairs Manager the Legal Officer provides legal information, legal counselling and legal assistance activities with IRC in Ukraine. The Legal Officer will be based at IRC’s office in Mykolaiv / Dnipro / Kharkiv. This role involves fieldwork and collaboration with IRC’s protection teams and external legal actors. The Legal Officer will serve as a key person to implement legal assistance activities along the displacement routes and provide the evidence base to inform the organization about the needs of affected population for program adjustment. The legal officer will provide legal services both at the Community Centers level and through mobile teams. He will also contribute to the general understanding of the legal context in Ukraine, as the situation and needs evolve. Additionally, the Legal Officer will support advocacy efforts and contribute to the legal context analysis to improve protection responses. Key Responsibilities create information content that responds to the legal needs of conflict-affected population, and provide information, either at the community center or other static centers and through mobile teams; work closely with IRC partners in order to support and guide the implementation of legal information, counselling and assistance; provide individual legal counselling to individuals in need of legal assistance, either at the community center or other static centers and through mobile teams; Provide secondary legal aid in coordination with Free Legal Aid Centers to assist individuals who do not qualify for free legal aid and cannot afford legal services; Identify and refer where needed complex legal cases requiring specialized assistance, including housing, land, and property (HLP) rights, IDP documentation, and employment rights; ensure continuous update of the service map and surrounding oblasts on legal actors and services; ensure referrals are made and received in a safe way and according to the SOPs, and ensure referrals received are followed-up and that the referral tracker is updated; Support the PRoL Manager, Legal Affairs Manager, Senior Social and Legal Advocacy Officer in data analysis related to legal needs; сontribute to advocacy initiatives by providing case examples and data on systemic legal challenges affecting displaced and conflict-affected individuals; engage with the Legal Protection Working Group (Legal PWG) and other coordination mechanisms to advocate for improved legal protection responses; constantly look for contacts among authorities and key humanitarian stakeholders and update the contact trackers; Contribute to the weekly movement plans for locations for legal activities on a weekly basis; Support and inform on the needs in term of legal assistance for people in Ukraine; Support IRC partners in implementing legal information, counselling, and assistance services; job_summary: Call for Applications Fellowships Grants Apply Now: CRI Postdoctoral Fellowship for Immunology Research The CRI Irvington Postdoctoral Fellowship funds early-career scientists in cancer immunology for three years. Applications are due on September 1, 2025, with eligibility criteria and funding details specified. Japheth Sirima 15th August 2025 (Last updated: 16th August 2025) 6 minutes read 0 comments Organization : Cancer Research Institute Duration : 3 years Application Deadline : September 1st, 2025 Overview The CRI Irvington Postdoctoral Fellowship Program funds early-career scientists worldwide to train in fundamental and cancer immunology. Applicants are evaluated on their qualifications, proposed research, sponsor, and training environment. The program supports hypothesis-driven, mechanistic studies that can advance understanding of the immune system’s role in cancer. In response to reduced federal funding, CRI is adding $2.5 million to fund 10 more fellowships this year, strengthening support for the next generation of immuno-oncology researchers. Financial Information Fellowships are for three years. Beginning with the March 1, 2025, deadline (for new awards beginning July 1, 2025). Newly awarded fellowships provide a stipend of $74,000 for the first year, $76,000 for the second year, and $78,000 for the third year. An allowance of $5,000 per year is allotted to the host institution for use at the sponsor’s discretion to help pay for the fellow’s research supplies, travel to scientific meetings, health insurance, and/or childcare. Deductions for administrative overhead are not allowed from either the stipend or the institutional allowance. Payments are made monthly in U.S. currency to the host institution. Eligibility Applicants for the CRI Irvington Postdoctoral Fellowship Program must be working in areas directly related to immunology or cancer immunology. An eligible project must fall into the broad field of immunology with relevance to solving the cancer problem. Applicants must have a doctoral degree by the date of award activation and must conduct their proposed research under a sponsor who holds a formal appointment as an assistant professor or higher rank at the host institution. Applicants with 5 or more years of relevant postdoctoral experience at the time of award activation are not eligible, with the exception of M.D. applicants, who should not include years of residency in this calculation. Only in exceptional circumstances will applicants who have already spent 3 or more years in a sponsor’s laboratory by the start date of fellowship be considered for a fellowship award. The fellowship can be performed in the United States or abroad but must take place at a non-profit institution. There are no citizenship restrictions. Only one fellow per sponsor may apply per application round, and faculty sponsors may not have more than three CRI-supported fellows at any time. Resubmissions: Applicants are permitted to resubmit their fellowship application at a subsequent deadline provided that the new application is improved to reflect progress. Changes to the application should be addressed within the subsequent application. Requirements Brief description of the applicant’s background and research accomplishments. Maximum 500 words. Provide a brief description of the knowledge and skillsets you aim to attain during your CRI funded training period. Describe the gaps in your knowledge and skillsets that have been missing from your training to this point and how specifically this training opportunity will help fill those gaps and enhance your understanding of immunology and/or cancer immunology (examples may include opportunities in the mentor/co-mentor lab, resources available at training institution, external training opportunities etc.) Maximum 250 words. List of other funding sources to which applications have been or will be submitted, with due dates. Applicant’s curriculum vitae and bibliography (NIH biosketch preferred). Brief summary of your project, including a description of how the proposed research is relevant to understanding the role of the immune system in cancer and/or the treatment of cancer through immunological means. Not to exceed 500 words. Abstract of research in non-technical English explaining the importance of the proposed research and its potential clinical relevance. The abstract will be used for fundraising purposes and submitted to CRI’s lay Board of Trustees. Abstract limited to 250 words. Specific aims of the project. Not to exceed 500 words. Concise research proposal (background, significance, materials and methods) not to exceed four (4) pages inclusive of tables and figures, exclusive of references. Letter from the sponsor introducing the applicant and describing the sponsor’s qualifications to direct the proposed research. The letter must contain assurance that the applicant’s project will be conducted under the direct supervision of the sponsor. Finally, sponsors are asked to indicate whether the application was written by the applicant and also whether any preliminary data included in the proposal was generated by the applicant or by the lab prior to the applicant’s arrival. Sponsor’s curriculum vitae/biosketch and a list of sponsor’s current research support. NIH biosketch is preferred. If including a formal C.V. then limit bibliography to past 5 years. Two letters of recommendation are required. One letter must be from the applicant’s thesis advisor. Applicants who received an M.D. or otherwise who do not have a thesis advisor should have some other qualified individual submit this letter. The second letter should be from an individual well acquainted with the applicant’s work. The sponsor may not submit one of these letters. If the sponsor was also the applicant’s thesis advisor, you must contact CRI for further instruction. Submitted as a PDF Please Note Your application is not considered submitted and complete unless all signatories have signed the application via DocuSign. If you encounter problems, please send an email to grants@cancerresearch.org. Be sure to note the application number, which will be assigned to you at the time of submission. Applications exceeding stated page limits will be disqualified. Only PDF documents will be accepted. All files must be submitted individually on the attachments page of the online application. Online applications will be accepted until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on the deadline date. If the deadline falls on the weekend, applications will be accepted until 11:59 p.m. that following Monday. We strongly suggest submitting your applications as early as possible to provide ample time in case your application is incomplete. Incomplete applications will not be considered. It is encouraged that Letters of Recommendation are submitted directly by the applicant via the online application form as a PDF. While direct online submission of these letters by the applicant is preferred, a referee may instead scan a copy of their letter as a PDF and email it to grants@cancerresearch.org. Please include with the email the name of the applicant and the application ID in the subject line of the email. All letters should be scanned in grayscale at a maximum resolution of 300 dpi to keep file size to a minimum. Do not scan in color, as this will significantly increase the file size, which could potentially cause uploading problems. Formatting Guidelines: Any documents you attach to your online application form must be typed single-space using a 12 point or larger font size.   • Only one fellow per sponsor may apply per application round, and faculty sponsors may not have more than three CRI-supported fellows at any time.
  • Resubmissions: Applicants are permitted to resubmit their fellowship application at a subsequent deadline provided that the new application is improved to reflect progress. Changes to the application should be addressed within the subsequent application.

Requirements

  • Brief description of the applicant’s background and research accomplishments. Maximum 500 words.
  • Provide a brief description of the knowledge and skillsets you aim to attain during your CRI funded training period. Describe the gaps in your knowledge and skillsets that have been missing from your training to this point and how specifically this training opportunity will help fill those gaps and enhance your understanding of immunology and/or cancer immunology (examples may include opportunities in the mentor/co-mentor lab, resources available at training institution, external training opportunities etc.) Maximum 250 words.
  • List of other funding sources to which applications have been or will be submitted, with due dates.
  • Applicant’s curriculum vitae and bibliography (NIH biosketch preferred).
  • Brief summary of your project, including a description of how the proposed research is relevant to understanding the role of the immune system in cancer and/or the treatment of cancer through immunological means. Not to exceed 500 words.
  • Abstract of research in non-technical English explaining the importance of the proposed research and its potential clinical relevance. The abstract will be used for fundraising purposes and submitted to CRI’s lay Board of Trustees. Abstract limited to 250 words.
  • Specific aims of the project. Not to exceed 500 words.
  • Concise research proposal (background, significance, materials and methods) not to exceed four (4) pages inclusive of tables and figures, exclusive of references.
  • Letter from the sponsor introducing the applicant and describing the sponsor’s qualifications to direct the proposed research. The letter must contain assurance that the applicant’s project will be conducted under the direct supervision of the sponsor. Finally, sponsors are asked to indicate whether the application was written by the applicant and also whether any preliminary data included in the proposal was generated by the applicant or by the lab prior to the applicant’s arrival.
  • Sponsor’s curriculum vitae/biosketch and a list of sponsor’s current research support. NIH biosketch is preferred. If including a formal C.V. then limit bibliography to past 5 years.
  • Two letters of recommendation are required. One letter must be from the applicant’s thesis advisor. Applicants who received an M.D. or otherwise who do not have a thesis advisor should have some other qualified individual submit this letter. The second letter should be from an individual well acquainted with the applicant’s work. The sponsor may not submit one of these letters. If the sponsor was also the applicant’s thesis advisor, you must contact CRI for further instruction.
  • Submitted as a PDF

Please Note

  • Your application is not considered submitted and complete unless all signatories have signed the application via DocuSign. If you encounter problems, please send an email to grants@cancerresearch.org. Be sure to note the application number, which will be assigned to you at the time of submission.
  • Applications exceeding stated page limits will be disqualified.
  • Only PDF documents will be accepted. All files must be submitted individually on the attachments page of the online application.
  • Online applications will be accepted until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on the deadline date. Please include with the email the name of the applicant and the application ID in the subject line of the email.
  • All letters should be scanned in grayscale at a maximum resolution of 300 dpi to keep file size to a minimum. Do not scan in color, as this will significantly increase the file size, which could potentially cause uploading problems.
  • Formatting Guidelines: Any documents you attach to your online application form must be typed single-space using a 12 point or larger font size.

This is a remote position.

Location: Fully remote, anywhere in the UK

Working Pattern: Approximately 70% Project Delivery | 30% Business Development

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

The Opportunity

We are a specialist project management consultancy supporting the development of nationally significant energy and infrastructure projects across England, Wales and Scotland.

As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager & Business Development Lead to take on a unique role combining client-facing project delivery with responsibility for coordinating and driving our business development activities.

Approximately 70% of your time will be focused on project management, working directly with clients to support complex infrastructure projects through the development lifecycle, from early concept and feasibility through planning, consenting and towards Final Investment Decision (FID).

The remaining 30% will be focused on business development. Business development is a shared responsibility across our consultancy, and you will provide the structure, coordination and momentum that ensures these collective activities translate into tangible opportunities and sustainable growth.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone who understands how professional services are bought and sold, can build trusted client relationships and can help turn the knowledge, networks and expertise of our wider team into commercial opportunities.

Project Management | c.70%

You will manage and support complex infrastructure projects on behalf of our clients, bringing together multidisciplinary teams and ensuring projects continue to progress against their objectives.

Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Leading client-side project management assignments across major energy and infrastructure programmes
  • Supporting projects from concept and feasibility through planning, consenting, development and towards FID
  • Establishing and managing project programmes, deliverables, budgets, risks and governance
  • Coordinating multidisciplinary work-streams including planning, environmental, engineering, land, commercial and stakeholder activities
  • Managing external consultants, contractors and technical specialists
  • Identifying project risks, dependencies and critical interfaces, and driving appropriate actions
  • Providing clear reporting, recommendations and decision support to clients
  • Building trusted relationships with client teams and project stakeholders
  • Maintaining an understanding of client priorities beyond the immediate scope of your assignment
  • Identifying opportunities where our wider team can provide additional value

Business Development | c.30%

You will lead the coordination of business development across the consultancy, working with colleagues to turn relationships, market intelligence and emerging client needs into a structured pipeline of opportunities.

Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Coordinating business development activities across the wider team
  • Establishing clear BD priorities, actions, ownership and follow-up
  • Maintaining oversight of the opportunity pipeline and ensuring opportunities continue to progress
  • Facilitating regular BD discussions and holding agreed actions to account
  • Identifying target clients, projects, markets and emerging opportunities
  • Coordinating account development activities for existing and prospective clients
  • Supporting colleagues to develop relationships and convert conversations into opportunities
  • Developing and coordinating capture strategies for priority opportunities
  • Leading or supporting proposals, bids, presentations and client meetings
  • Tracking pipeline activity, conversion and other relevant BD metrics
  • Identifying cross-selling opportunities across existing client relationships
  • Helping develop the consultancy's market positioning and routes to market
  • Providing insight on market trends, client requirements and competitor activity
  • Creating greater structure and consistency around how the business approaches BD
  • Driving momentum from initial opportunity identification through to secured work

You will not be solely responsible for originating new business. Everyone across the consultancy contributes to business development. Your role is to make sure that collective effort is coordinated, focused and consistently progressed.

Requirements

You will be an experienced project manager who also understands the commercial realities of working within a consultancy.

You should be comfortable delivering work directly for clients while also looking beyond your immediate assignment to understand where relationships can be developed, problems can be solved and new opportunities created.

Previous business development experience within a consultancy environment is essential.

Experience within environmental, planning or project management consultancy would be particularly relevant.

You do not necessarily need to have held a formal "Business Development" job title. We are equally interested in experienced consultants and project managers who have played a meaningful role in winning work, developing accounts, managing pipelines or coordinating BD activities alongside client delivery.

Essential Experience

  • Project management experience within infrastructure, energy, the built environment or another relevant sector
  • Experience operating within a professional services or consultancy environment
  • Demonstrable experience contributing to and winning new consultancy work
  • Experience developing client relationships and identifying commercial opportunities
  • Understanding of the consultancy sales cycle, from relationship development and opportunity identification through to proposal and contract award
  • Experience coordinating or contributing to bids, proposals and client presentations
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain momentum across both project delivery and BD activities
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of the relationship between project delivery, utilisation, client development and consultancy profitability
  • Confidence engaging with senior clients and stakeholders
  • Ability to influence and coordinate colleagues without relying on formal authority
  • Ability to operate independently within a remote and highly autonomous working environment

Particularly Relevant Experience

We would be particularly interested in hearing from candidates with consultancy experience in:

  • Environmental and EIA consultancy
  • Planning and consenting consultancy
  • Project management consultancy
  • Energy and infrastructure development
  • Engineering and technical consultancy

Experience supporting nationally significant or major infrastructure projects would also be advantageous, particularly within energy, electricity networks, renewables, nuclear, transport, water or other critical infrastructure.

Benefits

Benefits include:

  • A fully remote role that can be based anywhere in the UK
  • An autonomous, mature and completely flexible working environment
  • An entrepreneurial and supportive environment to help you develop your career in the direction that works for you
  • A very competitive remuneration package that includes profit-related bonus payments
  • Direct involvement in nationally important infrastructure projects
  • The opportunity to influence the growth and development of a specialist consultancy
  • A role offering a genuine combination of project delivery, commercial responsibility and business development leadership
