job_summary: Sr. Manager, Environment, Health, Safety (EHS) & Sustainability Site Leader (Lithia Springs) What's it like to work for Zoetis, the world leader in animal health? Zoetis means something a little different to every colleague, but at our core, our purpose 'to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals,' is what unites us in all our roles. We're a global animal health company dedicated to serving veterinarians, livestock producers and people who raise and care for farm and companion animals in more than 100 countries. And we're excited to become a part of the Douglasville, GA, community as we build our newest manufacturing facility to support our growing monoclonal antibody and vaccine portfolios. Position Summary: The Sr. Manager, EHS & Sustainability is the accountable site leader for EHS performance, regulatory posture, and sustainability execution in a fast-paced, complex manufacturing environment. As a member of the Site Leadership Team, this role shapes and deploys the site EHS strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned to enterprise priorities, ensuring safe, compliant, reliable, and resilient manufacturing and supply operations. This leader is highly visible on the production floor, laboratories, warehouses, and maintenance areas coaching leaders and colleagues to complete work safely, efficiently, and in full alignment with regulatory and company requirements. The Sr. Manager partners across operations, engineering, quality, technical services, supply chain, and logistics to embed EHS into business decisions and to build durable site capability. Key Accountabilities: * Own the site EHS & Sustainability strategy and 3-5 year roadmap, including capability-building plans, culture maturity, and capital prioritization. * Serve as the single accountable leader for site EHS governance, risk management, compliance assurance, and continuous improvement. * Lead the site through regulatory strategy, inspections, and negotiations to achieve strong outcomes and protect company interests. * Lead a multi-discipline EHS program and team through coaching, performance management, and succession planning. * Deliver measurable business outcomes including risk reduction, incident/loss reduction, compliance assurance, and cost avoidance. * Provide functional leadership and decision-making authority, including stop-work/stop-operation authority for imminent risk and approval of restart conditions. Position Responsibilities: Leadership, Governance, and Business Integration * Serve as a core member of the Site Leadership Team; advise the Site Head and leadership peers on risk, compliance posture, and sustainability performance. * Chair site EHS governance committee and run a disciplined operating rhythm (tiered reviews, risk register reviews, monthly performance reviews, executive updates). * Integrate EHS and Sustainability requirements into key business processes including capital projects, product/process transfers, equipment and material purchases, Management of Change, contractor management, and business continuity planning. * Build strong partnerships with value stream leaders and enabling functions (supply chain, quality, engineering, technical services, logistics, facilities) to drive safe, compliant execution and mature the site culture. Risk Management and Program Ownership: * Establish and maintain an enterprise-aligned site risk register covering operational, business continuity, legal, financial, reputational, and regulatory risks; communicate risk status and drive mitigation plans to completion. * Develop, implement, and sustain world-class programs in environmental compliance (air/water/waste), occupational safety, process safety, industrial hygiene, ergonomics, health/wellness, loss prevention, and sustainability. * Define and implement site standards, procedures, and tools to control risk and ensure compliance; ensure effective training and leader standard work. * Lead site-wide investigations and learning systems; coach shop-floor problem-solving using root-cause methods to drive systemic prevention. Capital Projects, Change, and Operational Readiness: * Own EHS requirements throughout project lifecycles (design, procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, and handover). * Set expectations and lead EHS deliverables for capital projects and operational changes, including HAZOPs, Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR), contractor safety management, permits to work, and readiness reviews. * Ensure EHS requirements are designed into new equipment, processes, and facility changes. Regulatory, External, and Stakeholder Leadership: * Act as the primary site interface with regulatory agencies (e.g., OSHA, EPA, FDA and applicable state/local authorities). * Lead inspection readiness, agency interactions, and enforcement response; ensure timely and effective corrective actions. * Manage regulatory obligations via an effective legal registry and compliance calendar; ensure accurate and timely submissions (facility reports, permits, and technical documents). * Lead stakeholder requests and assurance activities (CSR/Sustainability reporting, FM Global, BCP, RNR, customer audits/requests as applicable). Performance Management, Data, and Sustainability: * Define and manage site EHS and Sustainability KPIs (leading and lagging), ensuring data integrity, actionable analytics, and transparent reporting to site and regional/enterprise leadership. * Drive digital adoption and insights (e.g., Cority/PowerBI/ZenAI) to forecast risk, prioritize actions, and sustain performance. * Own the site sustainability plan and delivery. Culture and Capability Building: * Drive and promote the Home Safe, Every Day culture through visible leadership, coaching, communications, and engagement. * Build EHS ownership across the organization by developing leaders, supervisors, and frontline teams through training systems and practical coaching. Decision Rights and Authority: * Authority to stop work and/or stop operations for imminent risk, and to approve restart conditions in partnership with site leadership. * Authority to approve site EHS standards and governance requirements for capital projects, transfers, and MoC. * Ownership of site EHS operating budget and influence over EHS capital prioritization. Job Description

United Infrastructure are seeking a motivated and analytical Graduate Cost Controller to join our Project Controls team within our growing Power T&D business. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to develop a career in cost control, commercial management, and project finance within a professional and fast-paced environment

Working closely with our Project Managers, finance teams, supply chain and commercial stakeholders, you will support the accurate monitoring, reporting, and forecasting of project costs. You will gain hands on experience in financial analysis, budget management, cost forecasting, and performance reporting while developing a strong understanding of project controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with monitoring project costs against approved budgets and forecasts.
  • Maintain accurate cost trackers, budgets, commitments, and expenditure records.
  • Review and reconcile purchase orders, invoices, accruals, and actual costs.
  • Support the preparation of weekly and monthly cost reports.
  • Support the preparation of monthly application for payment.
  • Identify and investigate cost variances, escalating significant issues to the Project Controller / Project Controls Manager.
  • Assist with cost forecasting and estimating the expected final project cost.
  • Monitor committed costs and outstanding purchase orders to ensure accurate project reporting.
  • Work closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Planning and Risk teams to resolve cost queries.
  • Assist with month-end reporting, reconciliations, and financial close activities.
  • Maintain and update cost-control spreadsheets, dashboards, and reporting systems.
  • Support the identification of cost risks, potential overspends, and savings opportunities.
  • Produce cost summaries, dashboards, and management information as required.
  • Ensure project financial information is accurate, complete, and submitted within reporting deadlines.
  • Follow established cost-control procedures, financial policies, and governance requirements.
  • Contribute to improving cost-control processes, reporting templates, and data quality.
  • Develop an understanding of project financial performance, forecasting, and commercial controls.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.
  • Python Scripts.
  • Data transformation.
  • Qualification or training in Project Controls, Cost Management.
  • Demonstrate ability of working to tight deadlines and regular reporting cycles.
  • Any relevant industrial placements, internship, apprenticeship, or graduate experience would be advantageous.

Qualifications

Degree, HND, HNC in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related discipline.

Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.

God working knowledge or Excel and Microsoft Office.

Basic understanding of accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.

Ability to analyse financial information and identify cost variances and discrepancies.

Join us at United Infrastructure and be part of our mission to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions to the complex infrastructure needs of the UK.

job_summary: Standplaats Oss/projectlocaties Uren 40 uur Vakgebied Transport Opleiding Rijbewijs B & C met code 95 Het is nog vroeg als je het laadplein oprijdt. De accu’s zijn opgeladen en klaar voor gebruik. Jij laadt ze met de autolaadkraan op je vrachtwagen en rijdt naar het project. Daar wissel je de accu’s, zodat jouw collega’s weer een volle dag elektrische kunnen draaien op het project. Als chauffeur accutransport zorg jij ervoor dat onze elektrische machines op tijd van accu’s worden voorzien. Je rijdt tussen laadpleinen en projectlocaties en hebt onderweg contact met uitvoerders en machinisten. Zo draag jij iedere dag bij aan duurzaam en emissieloos bouwen. Wat ga je doen? Laden en lossen van accupakketten. Veilig vervoeren van accupakketten tussen laadpleinen en projectlocaties. Rijden met een elektrische vrachtwagen en autolaadkraan. Zelfstandig plannen van je routes en werkzaamheden. Afstemmen met uitvoerders en machinisten over de planning en het wisselen van accu’s. Je zorgt dat de juiste accu op het juiste moment op de juiste plek is. Transporten en ritten administratief verwerken. Wat breng je mee? Je rijdt veilig, werkt netjes en zorgt goed voor je materieel. Je weet dat jouw werk belangrijk is voor het hele project en houdt daarom goed contact met je collega’s. Om Het Werk Goed Te Kunnen Doen ben je in het bezit van een rijbewijs CE en Code 95; ervaring met een autolaadkraan mooi meegenomen; zijn een ADR-certificaat en hijsbewijs een pre. Heb je die nog niet? Dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden om deze te halen; heb je affiniteit met vrachtwagens, machines en techniek; werk je graag op verschillende grote projecten. Wat bieden wij jou? Een fulltime functie met veel zelfstandigheid. Een elektrische vrachtwagen en moderne materialen. Je ontvangt een salaris conform CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer, dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring. We bespreken dit graag met je in een persoonlijk gesprek. Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer. Werken aan innovatieve en duurzame projecten. Een betrokken familiebedrijf met korte lijnen en collega’s waarop je kunt rekenen. Inclusieve werkomgeving Wij geloven dat verschillende ervaringen, achtergronden en perspectieven ons sterker maken als organisatie. Daarom nodigen we iedereen die zich herkent in deze functie uit om te reageren. Of je nu al jaren onderweg bent of een nieuwe stap wilt zetten: bij Ploegam krijg je de ruimte om te laten zien wat je kunt. Direct solliciteren Wat maakt een echte Ploegammer? Iedereen die bij ons werkt is een echte Ploegammer. Allemaal zijn we uniek, maar wij zien toch ook wel wat overeenkomsten. Wij zijn samen werkers, die van aanpakken weten en die hun gezonde boerenverstand gebruiken. En we durven anders te kijken naar projecten en nieuwe oplossingen aan te dragen. Deze aanpak heeft ons al mooie dingen opgeleverd: de Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen, Ooijen-Wanssum, de fietsbrug over de A2 bij Eindhoven, de kunstzinnige Windboom in Bernheze en de eerste elektrische machine. Innovaties die ons verder brengen en die wij dankzij onze mensen hebben gerealiseerd. Samen duurzaam werken aan een mooier en veiliger Nederland Ploegam werkt vandaag voor een betere wereld morgen. Van plan tot uitvoering leggen we daarom veel nadruk op duurzame oplossingen, veiligheid voor onze mensen en de omgeving en het milieu. We slagen er in de afvalstromen te verminderen, we hergebruiken materialen en ontwikkelen elektrisch materieel. Op het vlak van veiligheid zetten we ook dagelijks stappen. Ondanks een sterke groei van ons bedrijf, neemt het aantal incidenten af. Ons motto: wij werken veilig of niet werpt vruchten af. En daar profiteren niet alleen onze mensen van, ook de omgeving merkt dat wij zorg en aandacht voor hen hebben. Want een goed project is een veilig uitgevoerd project. Bedrijfsprofiel Bij Ploegam werken jouw collega’s iedere dag vol passie aan projecten op het gebied van grond-, weg- en waterbouw en transport. Elke opdracht pakken we op de Ploegam-manier aan: gedreven, met kennis van zaken en vaak net even anders - dat is de kracht van ons familiebedrijf. Ploegam staat voor Ploegmakers Aannemingsmaatschappij. Begonnen als klein familiebedrijf in het Brabantse Vinkel, inmiddels uitgegroeid tot serieuze marktspeler met standplaats Oss. Een kleine greep uit onze projecten: wij verzwaren dijken, bouwen bruggen en kades, verplaatsen de loop van een rivier of leggen een wegennetwerk aan. Zo zorgen wij dat Nederland een beetje mooier, maar ook veiliger en duurzamer wordt. Marc Janssen Recruiter Contact opnemen Show more Show less

Wij geloven dat verschillende ervaringen, achtergronden en perspectieven ons sterker maken als organisatie. Daarom nodigen we iedereen die zich herkent in deze functie uit om te reageren. Of je nu al jaren onderweg bent of een nieuwe stap wilt zetten: bij Ploegam krijg je de ruimte om te laten zien wat je kunt.

Direct solliciteren

Wat maakt een echte Ploegammer?

Iedereen die bij ons werkt is een echte Ploegammer. Allemaal zijn we uniek, maar wij zien toch ook wel wat overeenkomsten. Wij zijn samen werkers, die van aanpakken weten en die hun gezonde boerenverstand gebruiken. En we durven anders te kijken naar projecten en nieuwe oplossingen aan te dragen. Deze aanpak heeft ons al mooie dingen opgeleverd: de Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen, Ooijen-Wanssum, de fietsbrug over de A2 bij Eindhoven, de kunstzinnige Windboom in Bernheze en de eerste elektrische machine. Ondanks een sterke groei van ons bedrijf, neemt het aantal incidenten af. Ons motto: wij werken veilig of niet werpt vruchten af. En daar profiteren niet alleen onze mensen van, ook de omgeving merkt dat wij zorg en aandacht voor hen hebben. Want een goed project is een veilig uitgevoerd project.

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Employment Type: Full-time - PST timezone

Contract Type: Contractor (Long-term)

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based company that owns and operates multiple pet product brands across Amazon and direct-to-consumer (Shopify) channels. With a strong presence in the U.S. market, the company is scaling rapidly, managing a complex multi-SKU, multi-brand portfolio in a highly competitive e-commerce environment.

Data plays a central role in how decisions are made, especially when it comes to pricing, growth efficiency, and long-term profitability.

About The Role

This is a hands-on, SQL-driven e-commerce analytics role with a strong focus on revenue, unit economics, LTV, and profitability.

We are looking for a Senior Analyst who can independently analyze Amazon Seller Central and Shopify data, build robust profitability and LTV models, and diagnose performance drops without relying on predefined dashboards.

This role goes beyond reporting. You will act as an analytical owner of the business performance, partnering closely with leadership to identify root causes, quantify impact, and recommend corrective actions that directly influence revenue and margins.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior E-commerce Data Analyst with strong, hands-on experience analyzing Amazon Seller Central and Shopify data to support revenue, profitability, and unit economics decisions.

This is a deep, SQL-driven analytics role, not a product, CRO, or customer success position. You will work directly with leadership and cross-functional teams to diagnose performance issues, build financial models, and provide clear, data-backed recommendations.

Why Work With Us?

  • Join a performance-driven team managing multiple consumer brands in the pet products space
  • Direct exposure to leadership and high-impact decision-making
  • Fully remote, long-term contractor role
  • Own profitability, LTV, and unit economics insights in a data-first organization

Key Responsibilities

Dashboard & Reporting

  • Build automated performance dashboards across Amazon and Shopify
  • Standardize KPIs and set up alerts for anomalies in key metrics

Deep-Dive Analytics & Insights

  • Perform hands-on, SQL-driven analysis of Amazon Seller Central and Shopify data
  • Independently diagnose performance drops across revenue, margin, subscriptions, and unit economics
  • Build profitability and LTV models by SKU, channel, and customer segment
  • Analyze Amazon marketplace performance, including fees, ads vs. organic impact, and contribution margin
  • Conduct subscription and retention analysis within Shopify/DTC environments
  • Deliver insights focused on revenue efficiency and profitability, beyond CRO or product optimization

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Present insights and recommendations directly to leadership
  • Partner with growth, marketing, operations, and product teams to drive action
  • Support data-driven pricing, inventory, and subscription decisions

High-Priority Projects (First 8–10 Weeks)

  • Set up automated reporting and baseline performance analysis
  • Analyze recent pricing changes and their impact on margins and velocity
  • Build an initial profitability and unit economics framework

Required Qualifications

Technical & Analytics

  • 3+ years in a senior data or e-commerce analytics role
  • Strong SQL proficiency (joins, subqueries, window functions)
  • Experience analyzing large e-commerce datasets

E-commerce Domain Expertise

  • Strong, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Shopify analytics (mandatory)
  • Proven ability to build SQL-based profitability and LTV models
  • Experience independently investigating performance declines using raw data
  • Solid understanding of Amazon marketplace economics and Shopify/DTC models, ideally including subscriptions
  • Profiles primarily focused on Product Analytics, CRO, or Customer Success without deep e-commerce financial analysis will not be considered

Nice to Have

  • Python or R for advanced analytics
  • Experience with BI tools (Triple Whale, Peel, Looker, Tableau)
  • Experience working with multi-brand e-commerce portfolios

Perform direct patient care within the scope of the Texas Nursing Practice Act, with emphasis on nursing process / outcomes for oncology patients with emphasis on blood cancer and disorders.What qualifications you will need:

Benefits

Medical City Dallas, offers a total rewards package that supports the health, life, career and retirement of our colleagues. The available plans and programs include:

Learn More About Employee Benefits

HCA Healthcare Co-Founder

About the role
DroneShield is looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Coordinator to join the Finance team. Reporting to the Head of Payroll, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end payroll function across our Australian and US operations. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who thrives on accuracy, enjoys improving processes, and is comfortable working across multiple payroll platforms.
Responsibilities, Duties and Expectations 
  • Support the Head of Payroll with processing monthly payroll cycles, including commissions and bonuses
  • Collaborate with outsourced payroll vendors to process payroll for employees across Australia and the US
  • Administer and maintain payroll systems, including Rippling, ADP, and Deel
  • Manage Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements through Deel, ensuring accurate and timely payments
  • Support the processing of terminations in accordance with statutory requirements
  • Ensure compliance with superannuation obligations
  • Support the reconciliation of annual PAYG reports to ATO Single Touch Payroll (STP)
  • Support payroll end-of-month reconciliations and reporting
  • Maintain and update employee personal and payroll records
  • Generate monthly reports on outstanding annual leave balances
  • Manage compliance filings with government agencies, ensuring accurate reporting of taxes, contributions, and benefits

  • Serve as the first point of contact for ad-hoc payroll queries from employees and managers

  • Support workers’ compensation payment processes

  • Collaborate with People Operations, Legal, and Finance to implement payroll-related changes, policies, and procedures.
  • Document and improve payroll processes and standard operating procedures
  • Support cross-functional projects and team initiatives as required
Qualifications, Experience and Skills 
Required
  • Tertiary qualification in Payroll, Human Resources, Finance, or a related field
  • 2–3 years of payroll processing experience, ideally across Australian payroll
  • Familiarity with interpreting Modern Awards and payroll-related legislation
  • Experience with payroll systems such as Rippling, ADP, or Deel (or similar platforms)
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a geographically distributed team
  • Willingness to work outside core hours on occasion to support global payroll cycles
Desirable:
  • Exposure to multi-country payroll
  • Experience with Employer of Record (EOR) platforms
  • Understanding of workers’ compensation processes
  • Process improvement mindset with a desire to enhance workflows and reduce manual effort

Samen met ruim 9.000 collega's werken we dagelijks aan veilige omgevingen voor opdrachtgevers met een grote maatschappelijke impact. Als HR Manager sta je midden in de operatie. Je bent zichtbaar, betrokken en schakelt moeiteloos tussen strategische HR-vraagstukken, tactische keuzes en de dagelijkse praktijk. Je krijgt veel ruimte om eigenaarschap te nemen en HR verder te professionaliseren binnen een regio die volop in ontwikkeling is. Wat ga je doen? Als HR Manager Beveiliging Zuid-Oost ben je lid van het regionale managementteam en een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de Directeur ZO, Klantmanagers en de Manager Planning. Samen zorgen jullie voor een sterke operatie, tevreden klanten en betrokken medewerkers. Je vertaalt de HR-strategie naar een concreet regionaal plan en zorgt dat dit ook daadwerkelijk wordt uitgevoerd. Daarbij werk je aan thema's als leiderschapsontwikkeling, verzuimreductie, duurzame inzetbaarheid, vitaliteit, recruitment, behoud van medewerkers, HR-analytics en employee engagement. Je bent niet alleen adviseur, maar ook aanjager. Je brengt scherpte, stelt de juiste vragen en helpt managers eigenaarschap te nemen. Wat je krijgt Je komt terecht in een professionele, maatschappelijk relevante organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. Bij Trigion krijg je de kans om HR zichtbaar van waarde te laten zijn voor medewerkers, managers én klanten. Wie je bent Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je bent businessgericht, mensgericht en resultaatgericht. Je voelt je thuis in een operationele omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar de kwaliteit van leiderschap direct zichtbaar is in de dagelijkse praktijk. Je bent iemand die schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je kunt conceptueel denken, maar weet ook wanneer er gewoon gehandeld moet worden. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Als persoon ben je enthousiast, inspirerend en verbindend. Je denkt in mogelijkheden, durft initiatief te nemen en weet vertrouwen te creëren. Je hebt gevoel voor de dynamiek van een operationele business en combineert professionaliteit met een praktische, hands-on mentaliteit. Waarom deze rol interessant is Dit is geen HR-rol vanaf de zijlijn. Je zit aan tafel waar de keuzes worden gemaakt, staat dicht op de operatie en werkt aan thema’s die direct bijdragen aan goed werkgeverschap en sterke dienstverlening. Je krijgt de kans om een regio verder te brengen, leiderschap te versterken en medewerkersbetrokkenheid concreet te vergroten. Laboratory General Supervisor – Milledgeville, GA

MainStreet Family Care operates over 60 fast-growing urgent care clinics across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, and North Carolina. As we continue expanding access to high-quality healthcare in rural communities throughout the Southeastern U.S., our mission remains the same: quality care, close to home.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a Laboratory General Supervisor to join our clinical team in the Milledgeville, GA area. This role plays a vital part in delivering accurate, timely diagnostic results through high-complexity real-time PCR testing and other laboratory procedures that directly impact patient care.

The Laboratory General Supervisor is responsible for all testing duties, quality standards, and MainStreet Family Care values. This position supports providers and lab techs by producing reliable laboratory results that enable efficient diagnosis and treatment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform CLIA high-complexity, real-time PCR testing in accordance with established protocols and regulatory requirements
  • Collect, prepare, process, and analyze patient specimens
  • Accurately document laboratory results in the electronic medical record
  • Perform quality control procedures, calibration, and routine maintenance on laboratory equipment
  • Ensure compliance with CLIA, OSHA, HIPAA, and infection control standards
  • Prepare and manage specimens for internal and external testing as needed
  • Monitor laboratory inventory, reagents, and expiration dates
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and report testing discrepancies, equipment issues, or quality concerns
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment
  • Collaborate with providers and clinical staff to support efficient operations
  • Providing supervision for day-to-day test performance

The Opportunity

  • Perform advanced molecular diagnostic testing in a growing healthcare organization
  • Make a direct impact on patient outcomes through accurate, rapid diagnostics
  • Support healthcare access in traditionally underserved communities
  • Competitive compensation with strong benefits and growth opportunities

Minimum Qualifications

  • Medical laboratory certification, or a Bachelor's degree in chemical, biological, clinical, or medical laboratory science that is compliant with CLIA standards.
  • Two (2) years of clinical laboratory experience, including molecular or PCR-based testing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Five (5) years of clinical laboratory experience
  • Experience performing high-complexity real-time PCR testing in a regulated laboratory environment
  • Experience in urgent care, primary care, or high-volume clinical settings

Required Skills, Knowledge, And Abilities

  • Proficiency in real-time PCR and molecular diagnostic techniques
  • Knowledge of high-complexity laboratory testing standards and CLIA requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and quality assurance practices
  • Ability to troubleshoot testing and equipment issues
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

Schedule

  • 10-hour shifts, scheduled across 7 days per week
  • Rotating shifts, including weekends and holidays as needed
  • Schedule may vary based on operational and testing volume needs

  • Position begins at $25/hr

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance contribution
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Employee Assistance Program

job_summary: Description de l'entreprise En tant que Project Engineer Fire Safety (M/F/X), vous travaillez au sein de la business unit Building . Building aide ses clients du secteur immobilier à exploiter leur patrimoine efficacement et durablement. Les experts de Vinçotte proposent des solutions dans les domaines de la qualité, sécurité et durabilité tout au long du cycle de vie d’un bâtiment : depuis sa Conception/contrôle – Construction – Exploitation jusqu’à et y compris sa démolition, de telle sorte que les bâtiments puissent être mis en service en temps utile, et ensuite être exploités de façon efficace (en particulier rentable) et durable. Vous intégrerez une équipe de conseillers en prévention et de responsables de la sécurité aux savoir-faire divers, qui s'investit chaque jour pour une société plus sûre et plus efficace. Fonction En tant que Project Engineer Fire Safety (M/F/X), vous effectuerez diverses missions de contrôle et de consultance dans le domaine de la prévention incendie, au regard de la législation et des normes en vigueur comme le RGPT, le Code, les Normes belges et européennes... Ces missions portent e.a. sur les domaines suivants: audits, analyses des risques, compartimentage, exercices d’évacuation, contrôles d’installations de sprinklage, évacuation des fumées et de la chaleur, contrôles des installations de détection incendie. Vous renforcerez également occasionnellement notre équipe de conseillers en prévention internes, chez l'un de nos principaux clients situé à Bruxelles, en cas de leur absences. Vous intervenez essentiellement sur les différents sites de nos clients situés dans la région de Bruxelles et de la Wallonie . Vous organisez vous-même vos visites chez les clients et rédigez ensuite un rapport fondé sur vos observations. Vous pouvez toujours vous fier à vos collègues : il s'agit d'experts motivés qui se feront un plaisir de vous aider. Vous les rencontrez régulièrement pour partager vos expériences. Par ailleurs, Vinçotte vous appuie également dans vos efforts pour approfondir et élargir vos connaissances. About eMigr8


eMigr8 is the tech platform for global talent mobility, relocation & settlement. eMigr8 tackles the multi-faceted challenge of legal migration, empowering individuals to become globally attractive talents. We bridge the information gap, navigate cumbersome processes, and ease integration hurdles using the power of AI & technology platforms. This unlocks their full potential in the global economy, addressing the talent shortages faced by countries worldwide.


We provide helpful tools, AI Assistants and Agents for the end to end journey of a talent moving from one country to another. An example is our Free Visa Assessment. Dr. Zenith (Beta) - eMigr8 AI Visa Architect gives an instant diagnosis on eligibility for some Talent Visas and where you stand today. Early Access at https://dub.sh/eMigr8VisaAssessmentln


eMigr8 provides expert coaching for tech talent visas, helping individuals enhance their profiles to qualify for pathways like the UK Global Talent Visa, US O-1 Visa, French Tech Visa, Canada Startup Visa, Australia National Innovation Visa, and more. Our personalised guidance ensures individuals meet global standards and achieve their relocation & settlement goals. Learn more at https://eMigr8.ai


The Role


The Corporate Benefits Strategy Lead is responsible for positioning eMigr8 Business as a corporate employee benefit. The insight here is straightforward: companies that employ or want to employ international talent are increasingly looking for mobility and immigration support as a structured benefit, not a one-off project.


You build the business case, commercial framework, and market positioning that gets eMigr8 Business bought and deployed as part of an employer's benefits stack. You understand how employee benefits decisions are made, who makes them, and what makes a benefit sticky for employees and compelling for employers.


About You


You have 8 or more years in employee benefits, HR consulting, or corporate compensation strategy. You have worked with employers who are thinking carefully about how to differentiate their total reward package and attract globally mobile talent.


You're a fit if you bring:


- Deep understanding of how employers buy, bundle, and manage employee benefits

- Experience designing benefits propositions and business cases for HR leadership

- Knowledge of the total reward landscape and where mobility and immigration support sits within it

- The ability to model the commercial framework for a benefits-as-a-service offering

- Relationships with employee benefits consultants, HR advisors, or total reward specialists

- Experience working across different employer segments, including both SMEs and large enterprises

- Commercial creativity in how you position and package a benefits proposition for different audiences


Employee benefits is a market where trust and familiarity drive purchasing decisions. Building that trust for a new kind of benefit is the core challenge of this role.


Why Join Now


- eMigr8 Business has not yet been positioned formally as a corporate benefit. That positioning is yours to create

- The market for globally-oriented employee benefits is expanding as international hiring becomes more common

- Equity in a business that has the potential to sit inside the benefits stack of hundreds of employers

- Direct collaboration with sales, marketing, and product teams to bring the benefits proposition to life

- The opportunity to define a category rather than compete inside one that already exists


What to Expect


This is a part-time, equity-first engagement at the pre-seed stage. In practice that means:


- Building the commercial framework and positioning for eMigr8 Business as an employee benefit

- Designing the benefits packaging model, including tiered access and pricing structures

- Working with the sales and partnerships teams to open conversations with benefits consultants and HR advisors

- Creating the materials that help employers understand and justify the investment internally

- Advising on how to embed eMigr8 Business in employer benefit selection and renewal cycles

- Feeding insights from the benefits market back into the product and proposition roadmap


This role is for a startup at a very early stage (pre-seed stage) and will start as a part-time equity role pending when the company meets fundraising or ARR metrics.


Where helpful, we may explore a short collaboration or onboarding period to ensure mutual fit but this is not a requirement for the right candidate.


Interview Process


Step 1: Introductory conversation with the eMigr8 Business team to explore your employee benefits background and commercial thinking.


Step 2: A brief discussion on how you would position and package eMigr8 Business as a corporate benefit and which employer segments you would target first.


Interested?


If you have spent your career helping employers build more compelling total reward propositions and want to define a new category within that space, we would like to hear from you. Apply with a short note on your background and a benefits proposition you have built or shaped.

What You'll Do

(Not listed in order of importance. Other duties may be assigned.)

  • Perform any appropriate inspection they are certified to perform following completion of engine repairs and modifications and the inspection of powerplants following their installation into the aircraft for final acceptance and release to service.
  • Make airworthiness determinations and providing suitable certification for the work performed including the Final Inspection and “Release to Service” of any work accomplished within the Repair Station's Rating either at the Repair Station or at any other location.

Position Requirements

  • Ability to express or exchange ideas verbally with peers, clients, and public.

  • Maintenance of regular attendance and punctuality within customary tolerances.
  • Looking for maintenance professionals who hold an A&P license with well-developed technical knowledge on TFE 731 and/ or PW 300 aircraft engines.
  • College degree OR high school graduate with technical vocational training and knowledge normally achieved through graduation from a university, trade school or military aircraft maintenance program, or an equivalent apprenticeship program.

  • Must have proper hand tools.

Job Summary

The Physical Therapist primary functions are to assess, reassess, develop, implement and evaluate plan of care, which are safe effective and provide for patient input, and follow the Physical Therapist standard of care. Employee must follow State licensure Act and National Professional Organization Practice Guidelines. Leadership, delegation, interdisciplinary team work, information management, performance improvement, customer service and time management are essential basic competencies. Needs general supervision.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

– Other duties may be assigned.

Evaluation

  • Performs initial therapy evaluations and re-evaluations utilizing evaluation techniques appropriate to patient’s age, culture, and admitting diagnosis to obtain a comprehensive view of patient’s functional skills, and impairments during the first 60 minutes of assessment time.
  • Makes an accurate assessment of patient’s strengths, weaknesses and pain.
  • Develops a well-defined plan of care and goals which include patient input and awareness of patient’s educational and cultural needs.
  • Is able to select, monitor, and modify appropriate equipment, procedure, and diagnostic testing methods.
  • Makes accurate clinical impressions when one or more physical impairments or diagnosis exist simultaneously.
  • Therapeutic goals are consistently measurable, objective, and reflective of the plan, and are modified and updated appropriately and timely.
  • Has developed skills or is actively pursuing development of skills in specialty areas (aquatics, lymphedema, manual therapy, Mckenzie, neurologic – NDT, orthopedic, sports, wound, vestibular, sensory integration, FCE’s, etc.) or in areas other than of primary responsibility assignment.

Treatment

  • Demonstrates the skill, professional judgment and knowledge base to provide effective treatment to patients of different age groups and cultures.
  • Consistently incorporates knowledge of growth and development issues into assessment of patient’s needs.
  • Provides treatment services appropriate to patient’s age group, culture and disability.
  • Is aware of resources available for different age groups and make appropriate referrals.
  • Demonstrates competency in all basic Clinical procedures and equipment for all common disorders.
  • Has developed new skills or is actively pursuing development of new skills in specialty areas, or in areas beyond primary assignment.
  • Follows ethical practices utilizing guidelines established by the Florida Board of Examiners and the NCH HealthCare System.
  • Delegate’s patient care to team members within their scope of practice.

Teaching

  • Provide formal and informal guidance, support, and teaching to internal and external customers.
  • Verbally communicates, to pertinent members of a patient’s healthcare team, to provide objective information about the patient’s deficits or impairments in a professional and timely manner,
  • Identifies educational needs in the NCH HealthCare System and attempts to meet those needs using formal and informal education strategies.
  • When covering for inpatients, post all precautions to educate nursing staff and other staff members to the limitations, needs and precautions.

Documentation

  • Consistently maintains timely, complete, and accurate written documentation as defined in policies and procedures.
  • Is able to locate information in the medical record.
  • Is able to perform a complete chart audit.
  • Medical record entries are legible.
  • Reports/completes all patient care information needed when a team member will be following up with a patient for treatment.

Clinical Management

  • Takes ownership for the clinical environment.
  • Takes responsibility for keeping a neat, organized, and clean therapeutic environment.
  • Keeps track of therapy and evaluation materials. Keeps materials organized and in good condition.
  • Monitors supply and ensures items are re-supplied when necessary.
  • Orders new material to meet the needs of the patient population of primary responsibility.
  • Ensure appropriate and needed material and supplies are easily located and available to covering therapist.
  • Accurately schedules and re-schedules patients, if applicable.

Facility Responsibilities

  • Takes ownership for all task related to scheduling and billing.
  • Consistently follows policies and procedures for ensuring patient schedules are up to date, correct and patients are informed of scheduling practices.
  • Communicates patient requested schedule changes to appropriate staff/community.
  • Turn in accurate, timely billing information and ensures patients are re-authorized per insurance requirement with adequate documentation of same and completes timely follow up phone calls when patients are no show. Completes FIM’s accurately and timely if applicable.

Certification/Continuing Education

  • Meets CEU requirements to maintain licensure and specialty certifications.
  • Attends course or complete self-study to stay current with issues related to primary population served.
  • Stays current with AIDS education and Medical Errors education, state laws.
  • Recognizes knowledge deficits and independently researches to meet the need of patients with uncommon presentations.

Education, Experience And Qualifications

  • Minimum of Master’s Degree in Physical Therapy.
  • No experience required.
  • Licensed as a Physical Therapist in the State of Florida.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required from the American Red Cross or American Heart Association.
  • Intermediate computer knowledge: Uses Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Windows.

  • Owning and enhancing the security posture of Azure cloud environment, web estate, and identity platforms

  • Leading the implementation and continuous improvement of web ingress controls including DDoS protection, certificate management, and traffic security

  • Acting as the primary technical security contact for Arctic Wolf and other security partners, coordinating investigations and response activities
  • Supporting the secure adoption of AI technologies through the development of appropriate controls, guardrails, and risk management frameworks

  • Experience engaging with security operations, MDR, or SOC providers to manage incidents and improve security controls

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to both technical and non-technical audiences

job_description_formatted:
"We are never going to lower the standard for any kid — instead we're going to raise the support to help them get there."

— Braden, Head Guide, Alpha Austin

Alpha is hiring.

The most supportive thing you can do for a student who hits 99% of their weekly goal is refuse to call it done. Not because you are indifferent, but because you believe they can clear the bar, and lowering it is the real failure.

You are not a teacher. At Alpha, students learn academics through AI-powered adaptive learning apps. No lectures. No textbooks. No whiteboard. Motivation and life skills, the two things schools normally squeeze into the margins, are the whole job here.

Picture a Tuesday. Half your day you run one-hour workshops for a K-8 cohort on public speaking, focus, and how to give and receive real feedback. The other half you sit with those same students one-on-one or in small groups, read their Coachbot analytics, and push each of them to 100% of their weekly app goals, using school currency, leaderboards, and the relationship you have built with them to break through resistance.

Your quarter comes down to three numbers: every student in your cohort hits their weekly app goals, every student passes the Test2Pass mastery check for each workshop, and 90% or more say they love you. Missing one of the three is missing the job.

The payoff is the day a student who spent September insisting they were bad at math asks you to raise their goal.

This is a full-time, on-site role at one of Alpha's campuses. We recruit nationally, so job boards may display this opportunity in nearby cities that do not have a campus yet.

Current openings for this salary tier are available in Scottsdale, AZ; Oklahoma City and Tulsa, OK; Nashville, TN; Austin, Dallas, Plano, Fort Worth, and Brownsville, TX.

If you're interested in another Alpha campus, apply anyway and tell us your preferred location—we'll consider you for the appropriate opening.

If you have coached youth sports, run a cabin at camp, or tutored a kid who wanted to quit, the last step before an offer is a full day on campus coaching real Alpha students. If that day is the part you want most, apply today

What You Will Be Doing

  • Leading one-hour life-skills workshops for K-8 cohorts on public speaking, focus, and giving and receiving feedback
  • Running daily 1:1 and small-group motivation sessions that push every student to 100% of their weekly app goals, using Coachbot analytics and Alpha's incentive systems (school currency, leaderboards)
  • Administering the Test2Pass mastery assessment for each life skill, then re-coaching any student who does not pass until they do
  • Adapting the workshop playbook, and building new sessions when you find a gap, so the same material lands with a kindergartener and with an 8th grader
  • Being both the adult who holds the standard and the adult your students choose to talk to

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Writing math and reading lesson plans, grading homework, or lecturing at a whiteboard; academic instruction lives in the apps
  • Running standardized test prep or answering for a class-wide test score
  • Handling parent conferences, emails, and complaints; campus leadership owns all parent-facing work
  • Crowd-controlling 30 students at once; cohorts are small and behavior work here is 1:1 coaching
  • Supervising kids at computers; motivation here is active and personal

Counselor Key Responsibilities

Ensure every student in your K-8 cohort hits their weekly learning goals, masters each life skill, and leaves the year saying they loved school.

Basic Requirements

  • Willing to work in person at an Alpha campus in Scottsdale, AZ; Oklahoma City or Tulsa, OK; Nashville, TN; or Austin, Dallas, Plano, Fort Worth, or Brownsville, TX - relocation support provided
  • Bachelor's degree in any subject
  • At least 3 years working directly with K-8 (elementary and middle school) students: classroom teaching, tutoring, athletic coaching, camp leadership, or youth program work
  • Comfortable letting adaptive learning software deliver the academic instruction while you own motivation and life-skills coaching
  • A personal record of high achievement, academic, athletic, or professional, that made holding a hard standard a habit rather than a posture
  • Stage presence strong enough to hold a room of 12-year-olds for an hour without raising your voice
  • Legal right to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

Nice-to-have Requirements

  • Youth athletics coaching, debate, drama, camp leadership, or after-school program work where you were personally accountable for kids hitting a specific goal
  • Experience teaching social-emotional learning (SEL) or durable-skills curricula
  • A student you can name who went from resistant or checked out to fully engaged, and the specific thing you did
  • Daily use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini

About Alpha

Join the team building school around student growth

Alpha reimagines the school day around faster learning, stronger mentorship, and more time for students to build real-world skills.

Roles with real student impact: Alpha hires teachers (guides), operators, admissions experts, school & curriculum leaders, and remote team members.

Education work that pays like it matters: Alpha offers six-figure roles for people ready to help build a radically better school experience.

A culture built for builders: Alpha is fast-moving, ambitious, and student focused. It’s for people who want to improve the system, not maintain it.

Alpha is where you can do the most meaningful work of your career.

job_summary: Vårt anställningserbjudande Välkommen att arbeta med oss på Geriatriska Kliniken på Danderyds Sjukhus! Vi räknas som sjukhusgeriatrik, vilket innebär en inriktning mot geriatriska patienter som har behov av geriatriskt omhändertagande men behöver vara kvar på akutsjukhuset. Vi har två slutenvårdsavdelningar, en kognitiv mottagning samt en akut dagvårdsavdelning (Gadva) i nära samarbete med akuten. En av våra slutenvårdsavdelningar ställs nu om till en GAVA med ökat fokus mot akutens flöde. Vi erbjuder ett brett vikariat på fyra månader med god handledning och nära samarbete med specialistläkare. Vi har engagerade medarbetare, ett öppet arbetsklimat, arbetsglädje och en god arbetsmiljö. Gadva (Geriatrisk Akut Dagvårdsavdelning) är placerad i nära anslutning till akuten. Patienter tas från triage eller akutsektioner och utreds på Gadva istället för på akuten. Målet är att bidra till en snabbare handläggning och geriatriskt omhändertagande redan från början. Den är öppen vardagar kl 08-20 med överlappande team av läkare och omvårdnadspersonal. GAVA (Geriatrisk AkutvårdsAvdelning) har 16 vårdplatser och kommer arbeta mer fokuserat mot akuten, med möjlighet till mer kontroller och ha en högre omsättning av patienter. Avd 37 är inriktad mot geriatriska patienter från andra akutsomatiska avdelningar som har behov av geriatrik men behöver fortsatt närhet till akutsjukhusets resurser. Vi arbetar multiprofessionellt på avdelningarna. Förutom kompetent och erfaren omvårdnadspersonal finns engagerade läkare, fysioterapeuter och arbetsterapeuter. Vi samarbetar även med logoped, kurator och dietist. Geriatriska kliniken ingår i verksamhetsområde Medicinska Specialiteter som utöver geriatriken innefattar Hudkliniken, Infektionskliniken, Internmedicin, Njurmedicin samt Specialistmedicin. The Brokerage Customer Support Specialist, acting as the Brokerage Assist Agent (BA Agent), plays a critical role in driving successful customer implementation and strengthening long‑term customer relationships. VETROSPACE is a leader in designing and manufacturing productive, private, and safe spaces for working, meeting and collaborating that take into account well-being. As we expand into new markets, we are looking for dynamic individuals to help drive our growth and impact. Find out more at www.vetrospace.com. 

 


In short 

As our Product Designer, you will be responsible for technical drawings and designs, playing a key role in ensuring the smooth transition from concept to production. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about design, technical problem-solving, and contributing to the growth of a start-up company. You will have a crucial impact on shaping the design environment and driving the creation of high-quality products.  


This position offers the opportunity to grow into a Technical Manager role, or if you already have the necessary experience and skills, you may step into that role directly. The final decision on the position will be based on an evaluation of your expertise and fit during the interview process. 


This role requires a full-time presence in our factory in Littoinen, where you will work closely with our R&D team, including the COO, Production & Quality Manager, and Technical Sales. 

 


Your key responsibilities 

  • Develop and manage the design environment, ensuring effective product management and smooth product lifecycle. 
  • Convert product documentation from 2D to 3D models, ensuring that all designs are accurate and scalable. 
  • Design and develop innovative products, focusing on both functionality and aesthetic quality. 
  • Collaborate with customers to create customized solutions for specific projects, while also supporting them through the technical aspects of design and implementation. 
  • Provide technical assistance to production teams and sales in solving design-related challenges. 
  • Be an active member of the R&D group and contribute to the production steering committee’s efforts to optimize designs for production and quality.

  • Proficiency in SolidWorks and PDM systems, with a strong background in product design and management. 
  • Experience with mechanical design of modular elements, including custom design solutions. 
  • A solid understanding of design transformation processes, from CAD to SolidWorks, and the ability to build and refine the design system for the company. 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding innovative solutions to design challenges. 
  • Strong ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Design (or equivalent). 
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in industrial design or related fields. 
  • Fluency in both Finnish and English. 

 

Skills that will set you stand out 

  • Knowledge of building technologies and ventilation solutions. 
  • Expertise in soundproofing and acoustical design. 
  • Familiarity with building electrical systems (230V), electronics / low voltage designs and related technical fields. 

 

What’s in it for You?  

  • A company with a very rapid international growth target.  
  • We offer hybrid working opportunities, with a headquarters office in the Helsinki region.  
  • Full support and mentoring from leadership and cross-functional teams.  
  • The chance to shape and accelerate your international career as we scale.  
  • A competitive compensation package based on your experience, skills, and qualifications.  

 

For any questions regarding the role or if you'd like to submit additional documents, feel free to reach out to Paulina Krakowska-Luoma, People & Culture Business Partner, at careers@vetrospace.com.

Cedarhurst Senior Living is a leading provider of senior living communities, dedicated to enriching the lives of residents through exceptional care and personalized services. Position Summary

The Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) is responsible for providing direct, hands-on support to residents with their daily personal care needs, ensuring comfort, dignity, and overall well-being. This role assists residents with activities of daily living, including grooming, hygiene, nutrition, mobility, and social engagement, while also monitoring and reporting changes in condition to the care team. CNAs promote a safe, clean, and supportive environment by assisting with meals, housekeeping, and resident activities, and by fostering effective communication with residents, families, and staff. Through compassionate care and teamwork, the CNA helps residents maintain the highest possible level of independence, health, and quality of life.

Essential Functions

  • Assist and provide direction to residents regarding their personal care needs, which include but are not limited to, grooming, hygiene, dressing, nutrition, etc.
  • Answers signal lights, bells, or intercom system to determine residents' needs using a proactive approach.
  • Takes and records temperature, blood pressure, pulse and respiration rates, and food and fluid intake and output, as directed.
  • Transports residents or assists residents with walking along with turning or repositioning residents alone or with assistance.
  • Changes bed linens, runs errands, directs visitors, and answers telephone.
  • Assists with laundry and housekeeping duties.
  • Assists residents to and from dining room as needed and assists with meals.
  • Encourages and assists residents to participate in activities.
  • Listens to and understands the problems of residents and reports observations immediately to the care team as needed.
  • Promote the physical, personal, and emotional wellbeing of each resident and strive to maintain the ultimate goal, which is to return the resident to their maximum level of self-care and independence, when possible.
  • Understand the resident’s Advance Directives and follows their wishes.
  • Ensure effective communication is being utilized by community staff with the residents’ families concerning residents’ care, encompassing their physical, personal, and emotional wellbeing.
  • Work well with others and take direction from management, as well as taking initiative with the capability to engage in conflict intervention and resolution for residents, families, employees, and others as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Completion of an accredited CNA program required.
  • One year of experience as a certified nursing assistant preferred.
  • CPR or BLS certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in common digital tools and applications, including Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Excel, Word), web-based platforms, electronic health record systems, and any HR-related systems as applicable.

Working Conditions

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

Assan Bilişim A.Ş., ana hissedarı Kibar Holding A.Ş’nin vizyon, misyon ve değerleri doğrultusunda, ileri teknolojiye sahip servis ve çözümleri sunarak Türkiye ve yurtdışındaki tüm grup şirketlerinin güvenilir iş ortağı olmayı hedeflemiş bir teknoloji grup şirketidir. Geliştirdiğimiz analitik modelleri Assan Bilişim bünyesinde geliştirmekte olduğumuz ürünlerde kullanmaktayız. Analitik çözümlerimizi Microsoft Azure sistemleri üzerinden geliştirdiğimiz modellerle ve kendi sunucularımızda geliştirdiğimiz servislerle sistemlere entegre etmekteyiz. Bu tanımlara uygun bir aday olduğunu düşünüyorsan, sende aramıza katılmak için başvurunu bırakabilirsin. SENİN İÇİN NELER VAR? Daha dinamik ve esnek bir iş hayatı için "uzaktan+, hibrit ve ofisten/yerinde+" olmak üzere 3 yeni çalışma modeli: Uzaktan+: Haftada en az 1 (bir) gün yerinde/ofiste çalışılır. Hibrit: Haftada en az 2 (iki) ya da 3 (üç) gün yerinde/ofiste çalışılır. Ofisten/yerinde: Haftada en az 4 (dört) ya da 5 (beş) gün yerinde/ofiste çalışılır. Yeni çalışma modeli ile Kibar Topluluğu’nda yer alan farklı lokasyonlardaki tüm ofislerden çalışma imkanı Güç BİZde 2.0 ile her kademede birbirinden öğrenmeyi destekleyecek iç eğitimler, yetkinlik ve teknik gelişimi destekleyecek gelişim programları BİZflex Esnek Yan Faydalar Programı ile yıllık toplam yan fayda tutarı, farklı markalarda seçilen hediye çekleri ile yıl boyunca kullanılabilir. Değer katan ve fark yaratan her türlü başarı ve performansın anlık olarak takdir edilmesini sağlayan BİZPlus Takdir&Tanıma Programı "Her başarılı proje önce bir fikir damlası ile başlar ve dalgalar halinde yayılır" mottosuyla hayata geçirdiğimiz ve Grubumuzu stratejik hedeflerine ulaştırmayı, yetkinliğe dayalı başarıyı tanımayı ve ödüllendirmeyi amaçladığımız Asım Kibar Mavi Damla Ödülleri. Çeşitlilik ve Kapsayıcılık çalışmalarının yürütüldüğü BİZ Eşitiz programı Yeni baba olan arkadaşlarımızın çocuklarıyla ilgili sorumluluklarına daha fazla vakit ayırabilmesi için 14 günlük babalık izni. Her yıl online ve fiziksel olarak birçok branşta gerçekleştirdiğimiz Kibar Spor Şenlikleri. Kibar Holding ve Grup Şirketlerinde yapılan tüm gönüllülük çalışmalarını tek çatı altında buluşturan ve toplum yararına daha fazla katkı sağlamayı amaçlayan Kibar Gönüllülleri. Cep telefonu ve şirket hattı Yemekhane / Sodexo (Pluxee) Çalışma arkadaşlarımız, adaylarımız ve tüm iç/dış paydaşlarımızla “BİZ Birlikte Güçlüyüz” işveren markası mottomuz doğrultusunda iş birliği sağlıyoruz.   • Using automated tools to extract master data from primary and secondary sources, then analysing it to understand and improve data quality

  • Supporting the business with data cleanse activities using internal software and portals

  • Running user acceptance testing across the data stream, including documentation, communication and issue resolution

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Previous experience working in a data environment, with good business acumen and a real appreciation of data governance
  • Strong SQL ability alongside excellent Google and data analysis skills
  • A genuinely excellent communicator who can relate to a broad range of people and write clear technical documentation
  • Someone who works well on their own initiative with minimal supervision
  • Sharp attention to detail, forward thinking and naturally innovative

Nice to have:

  • An understanding or interest in Artificial Intelligence
  • Superior organisational skills, with the ability to plan and prioritise your own workload
  • A deep understanding of working in a similar data environment

You will join a collaborative Data Team within Finance, working closely with stakeholders across multiple brands and tackling problems with real complexity and reach. You will need to balance the big picture with the fine detail, and your work will directly influence decisions at group level.

If you want data work that has genuine impact and the trust to get on and deliver it, we would love to hear from you. Apply today.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Portfoliomanager CSMO ben je verantwoordelijk voor het samenbrengen en structureren van het strategische en commerciële portfolio m.b.t. verandering en continuïteit binnen het CSMO-domein. Eastern Commercial is the full-service commercial general contracting division of Eastern Companies. Building on decades of experience in building envelope construction, we deliver comprehensive construction solutions across the education, healthcare, hospitality, multifamily, commercial, and institutional sectors.

Our team is committed to excellence in every phase of construction, combining technical expertise, collaboration, and accountability to deliver high-quality projects safely, on time, and within budget. Why Join Us?

At Eastern Commercial, you'll be part of a growing organization built on integrity, accountability, and quality craftsmanship. We empower our team members to take ownership, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to projects that shape communities across the Southeast and Mid-Atlantic. If you're looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact, grow your career, and be part of a team committed to excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Summary

The Project Superintendent is responsible for leading day-to-day field operations to ensure the safe, timely, and high-quality execution of construction projects. This role works closely with the Project Manager to deliver projects that meet or exceed client expectations, contract documents, and internal performance goals. The Superintendent will manage field personnel, subcontractors, site logistics, and all jobsite coordination while upholding the highest standards of safety, quality, and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities

Field Operations & Project Execution

  • Lead daily site operations, overseeing all field activities, subcontractors, and deliveries
  • Maintain jobsite safety protocols; enforce all OSHA, company, and regulatory requirements
  • Manage schedule execution and updates; take ownership of short-term and long-range planning
  • Coordinate inspections, manage quality control, and enforce contract document compliance
  • Maintain clean, organized, and professional jobsite environments at all times

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Supervise and mentor field staff and Field Engineers
  • Serve as the primary field liaison to Owners, A/E teams, inspectors, and users
  • Provide daily coordination between trades to avoid conflicts and improve workflow
  • Participate in preconstruction efforts including buyout scope reviews and schedule input

Documentation & Controls

  • Ensure Procore is accurately maintained with RFIs, photos, daily logs, as-builts, and look-aheads
  • Lead the project through punch list, closeout, and turnover, ensuring thorough documentation
  • Track and manage site logistics, manpower forecasting, and resource planning

Safety, Schedule & Quality Management

  • Champion a safety-first culture—ensure all personnel go home safe
  • Maintain control of project schedule—no excuse mindset for missed dates
  • Ensure quality standards are upheld throughout the build; anticipate and resolve field issues

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Zero safety incidents or violations
  • Weekly schedule adherence and updated look-aheads
  • Clean jobsite with minimal rework and field-driven delays
  • Field documentation compliance in Procore
  • Trade contractor performance and accountability
  • On-time completion of project closeout and owner training

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or related field preferred
  • 7–15 years of field experience on commercial projects valued at $25M+
  • Proficient in Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Office Suite
  • 30-Hour OSHA, NPDES Blue Card, and Procore certification (or obtained during onboarding)
  • Ability to lead with confidence, communicate clearly, and solve problems proactively
  • Strong understanding of sequencing, trade coordination, and construction workflows

Expectations

  • Own the site—be the leader on all field-related matters
  • Build and mentor your team; invest in their growth
  • Plan ahead, execute with discipline, and resolve issues before they become problems
  • Represent Eastern Builders with integrity, professionalism, and pride
  • Build Brilliantly—deliver a high-performing project and enjoy the journey

Reports To

General Superintendent / Senior Project Manager

Coordinates / Assists With

  • Project Manager
  • Senior Project Manager
  • Project Engineers
  • Subcontractors & Vendors

Employment Details

  • Full-Time, Salaried 
  • Location: Onsite – Fort Bragg, NC

Benefits

  • Up to 85% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to 5% 
  • Discretionary Paid Time Off (DPTO) - We offer a Discretionary Paid Time Off (DPTO) program to support work-life balance. Employees may request time off in advance through the company system, with manager approval based on business needs
  • Plum Benefits: Employee discounts on entertainment, travel, shopping, and lifestyle experiences
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)

Physical Requirements

  • Work in both office and construction site environments.
  • Traverse active construction sites for extended periods, up to a half mile per day.
  • Communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through electronic communication.
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl during site visits and inspections.
  • Occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

EEO

  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre le projet
  • Identifier les problématiques des jeunes du quartier (délinquance, insertion, rupture familiale, comportements à risques, ruptures scolaires, …) et élaborer un plan d’actions cohérent avec les réalités locales.

  • S’informe des réglementations, des circulaires, des appels à projets et des dispositifs concernant les jeunes ;

Animer des actions

  • Accueillir un public de jeunes de 11 à 18 ans ;
  • Assurer un travail d’animation de groupes ;
  • Organiser, coordonner et animer des actions de prévention collectives dans les champs d’interventions suivants : activités artistiques, sport, loisirs, culture, éducation, santé, mobilité…

  • Participer aux instances de prévention ;

Assurer la gestion administrative, financière et matérielle de son activité

Role Snapshot

Client-facing Life Sciences manufacturing Manager who leads technology-enabled transformation workstreams that improve plant performance, quality, compliance, and supply reliability. The role combines practical manufacturing knowledge with digital, data, AI, and delivery skills to turn operational needs into solutions that work in regulated environments.

The Opportunity

As a Manager in Supply Chain Manufacturing, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical-device manufacturers to improve how production, quality, laboratory, engineering, and technology teams operate together. You will lead defined workstreams from assessment and requirements through solution design, implementation, testing, adoption, and stabilization.

This is a techno-functional delivery role. You will facilitate decisions with client teams, translate plant-floor needs into actionable requirements, coordinate functional and technical specialists, and take ownership of the quality and progress of your workstream. You will contribute to broader program planning and value realization while working with senior engagement leaders on cross-program decisions and commercial matters.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead client-facing workstreams in Life Sciences manufacturing transformation, with clear ownership of plans, deliverables, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Assess current-state production and quality processes, user needs, system landscapes, data flows, performance gaps, and site constraints through workshops, data analysis, and plant engagement.
  • Translate priorities such as yield, throughput, right-first-time execution, batch-cycle time, deviation reduction, asset reliability, and supply continuity into process designs, requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable improvements.
  • Develop functional designs for relevant capabilities such as batch execution, electronic batch records, recipe management, genealogy, review by exception, connected-worker workflows, maintenance, and performance management.
  • Coordinate integration requirements across MES/MOM, ERP, LIMS, QMS, historians, SCADA, DCS/PLC, asset-management systems, and cloud or edge platforms, working with architecture, automation, and cybersecurity specialists.
  • Define and review data mappings, asset and batch context, master-data needs, interface specifications, and data-quality controls needed for reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.
  • Help deliver analytics and AI use cases, such as process monitoring, predictive maintenance, deviation investigation support, and decision support, by assessing data readiness, workflow fit, evaluation criteria, and human oversight.
  • Work with client quality and validation teams to reflect applicable GxP, data-integrity, electronic-record, change-control, and validation or risk-based assurance requirements in workstream deliverables.
  • Oversee configuration activities and lead functional testing, defect resolution, deployment readiness, training, cutover support, hypercare, and handover for your workstream.
  • Facilitate working sessions across manufacturing, quality, MS&T, engineering, supply chain, IT, OT, data, and technology-vendor teams; escalate decisions and dependencies that affect the broader program.
  • Manage workstream scope, schedule, resources, quality, and risks; provide clear status updates and contribute to estimates, proposals, and follow-on opportunity shaping.
  • Coach junior team members, review their work products, and capture reusable requirements, design patterns, and delivery lessons.

Skills And Attributes For Success

You will bring:

  • Practical understanding of Life Sciences manufacturing and the connections among production, quality, laboratory operations, engineering, and supply chain.
  • The ability to turn operational problems into clear workflows, functional requirements, user stories, data needs, interface requirements, and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing systems and IT/OT data flows, with enough technical fluency to collaborate effectively with automation engineers, architects, data engineers, developers, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Familiarity with batch and equipment data, data contextualization, APIs, historians, and industrial connectivity patterns relevant to the solution being delivered.
  • Sound judgment about when analytics or AI is useful, what data and controls it requires, and how people will use its outputs in manufacturing or quality workflows.
  • Strong workshop facilitation, structured problem-solving, client communication, team coordination, and delivery-risk management skills.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, manufacturing, supply chain, information systems, business, or a related discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in Life Sciences manufacturing, manufacturing technology, operational excellence, industrial data and AI, technology consulting, or a related field.
  • Experience leading a client-facing manufacturing, digital, data, or technology workstream through design and at least one implementation or deployment phase.
  • Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or comparably regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Experience translating manufacturing needs into process, functional, data, integration, or testing deliverables and coordinating business and technical contributors.
  • Practical understanding of GxP manufacturing and the documentation, change-control, quality, and data-integrity considerations relevant to digital solutions.
  • Ability to travel as needed based on business and role requirements. Travel can range from 80-100%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Experience with drug substance, drug product, biologics, sterile manufacturing, medical devices, or clinical-to-commercial scale-up.
  • Delivery experience with MES/MOM, electronic batch records, recipe management, connected-worker tools, industrial analytics, or manufacturing data platforms.
  • Familiarity with ISA-88/IEC 61512, ISA-95/IEC 62264, OPC UA/IEC 62541, MQTT/Sparkplug, or unified-namespace approaches as relevant to client systems.
  • Awareness of OT cybersecurity practices informed by ISA/IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82.
  • Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and continuous improvement practices, including the use of manufacturing data to monitor process performance, identify variability, and improve quality, throughput, and operational performance.
  • Experience supporting computer system validation or risk-based computer software assurance where applicable to the regulated product and system.
  • Experience with multi-site deployments, plant modernization, technology transfer, or the development of reusable solution assets.
  • A relevant program-management, operational-excellence, cloud, data, or manufacturing-technology certification.

We are looking for a Manager who is comfortable with plant-floor realities and capable of leading a mixed functional and technical team through implementation. Our Employee Benefits Package shows how much we value our team. Some benefits include: Employee ownership opportunities. Company-paid benefits such as life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability, subject to applicable waiting periods. Paid time off (PTO) or Paid Sick Leave (PSL).
