Position Summary

Full-Time Support Staff, new positions

(First consideration for support staff and academic positions will be given to internal applicants in accordance with the respective collective agreements)

Under the direction of the Supervisor, Child Development Centres, the Early Childhood Educator (ECE) is responsible for planning and implementing a high-quality Early Childhood Education program for children, assisting in supporting students enrolled in ECE-related programs, modelling the philosophy and Program Statement, and developing and maintaining professional relationships with families. The successful candidate is responsible for upholding the Child Care and Early Years Act (CCEYA) along with the guidelines in the college staff handbook.

Successful candidates will be required to conduct work on-site five days per week, Monday to Friday, between 7:30 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. at the Silverheights Childcare Centre located at 390 Scott Road, Cambridge. The target start date for these positions is October 1, 2026.

Responsibilities

Program planning and child development

  • Plan, implement, and adapt high-quality early learning programs in alignment with the Regional Early Years Engage Framework and established early childhood education best practices
  • Create inclusive, engaging learning environments that respond to the individual needs, interests, developmental stages, and capabilities of children and families
  • Facilitate positive, child-centred, and child-initiated learning experiences that support children's growth and development
  • Observe, assess, and document children's learning and development using appropriate assessment tools and pedagogical documentation practices
  • Identify and initiate referrals to additional resource consultants and specialized supports when required
  • Complete required documentation, records, and reports in a timely and accurate manner

Health, safety and well-being

  • Promote and maintain a safe, healthy, and nurturing environment for all children
  • Provide continuous supervision of children during all activities, routines, and play experiences
  • Ensure compliance with the Child Care and Early Years Act, licensing requirements, centre policies, and staff handbook guidelines
  • Monitor and respond appropriately to children's physical, emotional, and developmental needs

Family engagement and communication

  • Establish and maintain positive, professional relationships with families that support children's success and well-being
  • Participate in family intake and orientation processes
  • Communicate regularly with families regarding their child's daily experiences, development, and progress
  • Meet privately with families, as needed, to discuss child development, concerns, or goals
  • Provide consultation, guidance, and support to families while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism

Student mentorship and academic collaboration

  • Support Early Childhood Education students through mentorship and modelling of effective teaching practices
  • Provide constructive verbal feedback to students and share observations with supervisors responsible for evaluations
  • Contribute to academic program initiatives and partnerships as appropriate

Teamwork and professional collaboration

  • Work collaboratively as a contributing member of the classroom, centre, academic program, and interdisciplinary teams
  • Support colleagues, students, and external consultants by sharing knowledge, expertise, and resources
  • Report incidents, concerns, parent requests, schedule changes, and other significant matters to the appropriate supervisor
  • Participate in ongoing professional development activities to maintain and enhance professional knowledge and skills

Qualifications

  • A two-year diploma in Early Childhood Education is required
  • Membership in good standing with the College of Early Childhood Educators (CECE) of Ontario is required
  • Experience working in a licensed childcare setting is required, preferably one that provides placement opportunities for ECE students
  • Valid Standard First Aid and CPR certification is required
  • Completion of a satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Check is required
  • Ability to comply with immunization requirements
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Ability to work creatively, flexibly, and collaboratively in a team environment
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

The F&B Kitchen staff is under the direct supervision of the Food and Beverage Supervisor. F&B Kitchen Staff is responsible for providing quality food and service. Also, adhere to Lucky Star employee handbook and food and beverage policies and procedures.

OPERATIONS & COMPLIANCE MANAGER (M/F)


THE JOB:

We are delighted to support our client, an international private equity firm, in the recruitment of their Operational and Compliance Manager. The Compliance Manager interact with the Chief Compliance Officer of the firm and make sure that there is a robust compliance framework in the organisation.

  • Develop, implement, and update an effective legal compliance program including evaluation and maintenance of compliance systems and software.
  • Yearly review and revise fund entities and companies AML/CFT policies (for CSSF and AED).
  • Create sound internal controls and monitor adherence to them. Proactively audit processes, practices, and documents to identify weaknesses.
  • Evaluate business activities (e.g. investments or divestments) to assess compliance risk.
  • Review of the various reporting to CSSF and AED prepared by local providers.
  • Dealing and being the point of contact for the regulator (CSSF) and fund investors on compliance matters
  • Enhances compliance function and organization reputation by answering questions and responding to requests and by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests from internal or external sources (regulators, fund investors).
  • Continuous update of the Luxembourg Register of Effectives Beneficiaries (RBE) for the Luxembourg companies and funds’ compartments.
  • Continuous update of the KYC required by the counterparties of the Luxembourg companies.
  • Coordinate with local tax advisors to ensure preparation of the tax returns (CIT, MBT, NWT) and VAT returns.
  • Review of the tax returns and VAT returns.
  • Coordinate with local tax advisors to ensure proper filing of the tax and returns.
  • Gather and ensure the relevance of the investors’ details required for the preparation of the annual reporting for FATCA & CRS made by providers.
  • Coordinate with local providers to ensure proper preparation and filing of FATCA & CRS returns.
  • Ensure proper filing of the companies’ annual accounts (incl. reception of RCS and RBE extracts for each of them).
  • Ensure proper update of the companies’ registers.
  • Review and signature of NDAs/NBOs/NRLs.


THE PROFILE:

  • Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or Law
  • Proven experience in KYC or AML Compliance, and tax, ideally gained from working in a similar role or industry is preferred.
  • Understanding of regulatory requirements, especially in relation to Anti-Money Laundering/Know-Your-Customer frameworks, policies, procedures, and tax
  • Knowledge of the full remit of compliance competencies with a comprehensive understanding of the various roles in the investment fund industry, and more particularly of the operating mechanisms of a management company, but also of a custodian bank, transfer agent, fund administration and the related regulatory framework, will be considered as an asset
  • At ease using computer systems and new technologies as well as an interest in these areas
  • Highly driven and motivated individual, with the patience and ambition to build a rewarding career with a leading firm. Strong commitment and ability to meet deadlines
  • Have strong planning and organizing skills, pro-activeness, flexibility, multi-tasking and the ability to self-manage your workload. The role requires the individual to be able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously across a variety of entities and outsourced service providers.
  • Highly personable, team player with the desire and ability to create relationships across the group and external service providers
  • Be fluent in English. Knowledge of French, Italian, Spanish, German languages is an asset


THE CLIENT:

Our client is a small and reputable private equity firm, located in the city center.

Wij zoeken een gedreven Oracle (Cloud) autoriteit die ons team komt versterken. Als Oracle Cloud Specialist binnen ons team ben je de tactisch en technisch product manager (TPM) die verantwoordelijk is voor de lifecycle/doorontwikkeling en het support op de Oracle Cloud @ Customer bij UWV. Je voert regie over de contractafspraken met de leveranciers DXC en Oracle ten behoeve van onze OCI public en Cloud@Customer platform dienstverlening (Exadata Cloud@Customer, Compute Cloud@Customer en Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance) en je bent samen met de servicemanager(s) verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten van een Oracle Center of Excellence dat ervoor zorgt dat de UWV organisatie optimaal gebruik kan maken van dit moderne platform met de introductie van o.a. Infrastructure As Code, Oracle 26AI, Oracle Autonomous Database en Database cloning en anonimisering, en daarnaast het integreren van de juiste OCI Market Place Images voor Middleware. Wat je gaat doen Als onderdeel van de afdeling Infrastructuur Ontwikkeling en Regie (IO&R) in samenwerking met architecten ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van veilige en stabiele Oracle platformen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen van externe IT-partners en leveranciers voor het dagelijks beheer en onderhoud van de Oracle-omgevingen, en voor het bewaken van Service Level Agreements (SLA's) en prestatie-indicatoren (KPI's) van de database-dienstverlening. Je geeft als expert en bewaker van de Oracle-standaarden invulling aan een Oracle Centre of Excellence waarin je samenwerkt met leveranciers, architecten en diverse UWV DevOps teams om: Businesswensen te vertalen naar concrete, toekomstbestendige Oracle-oplossingen en database-architecturen. Regie te voeren op de roadmap van het Oracle-landschap, inclusief updates, releases en de transitie naar de (hybride) cloud-omgeving. Management, vakgroep en clusterleiding te informeren en adviseren Toe te zien op databeveiliging, compliance (privacywetgeving) en de inrichting van back-up- en disaster recovery-scenario's. Impactanalyses en technische ontwerpen die door leveranciers of projectteams worden aangeleverd te beoordelen. Capaciteitsmanagement, licentiebeheer (Oracle LMS) en kostenoptimalisatie in te richten. Full stack enablement in te richten met herbruikbare automatisering en documentatie volgens het Paved-Road concept Wat we van je verwachten HBO+ denk- en werkniveau. Aantoonbare ervaring met Oracle producten en Oracle (Public) Cloud. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en in staat om te werken in een dynamische en veranderende omgeving. Je bent een teamplayer en kan eenvoudig schakelen tussen diverse DevOps teams die je ondersteund. To the point en komt afspraken na. Wat kun je van ons verwachten Als UWV willen we het beste voor onze mensen betekenen. Ons streven is een goede werk-privé balans en ontwikkelperspectief. Kans op persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei binnen de organisatie met diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden. We bieden verder een uitdagende baan met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, een goed salaris, een 13e maand en een modern keuzeplan. De inschaling en het salaris is afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring en bedraagt minimaal € 4.073,- en maximaal € 6.909,- per maand op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Iets meer over ons Je komt te werken in een toegewijd Cloud Platform Team dat de regie voert over onze IT-dienstverlening. Binnen het team heerst een open en collegiale sfeer, waarbij samenwerking en sparren over technologische oplossingen centraal staan, je hebt een nauwe samenwerking met je service owner. We werken agile en stimuleren continu leren en ontwikkelen. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze ICT-diensten voldoen aan de hoogste standaarden en bijdragen aan de missie van UWV. Bij UWV werken 1.500 van de ruim 23.000 medewerkers aan de informatievoorziening. De afdeling ICT Services speelt hierin met 800 medewerkers een centrale rol. Samen met externe leveranciers zorgen zij voor de gehele IT-infrastructuur. Het team Infra Ontwikkeling & Regie (IO&R) is verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, het beheer en onderhoud van diverse ICT-diensten zoals Hosting, TAB, Netwerk, Werkplek en Telefonie. Daarnaast houdt IO&R zich bezig met integrale Security- & Compliance-dienstverlening. Iets voor jou? Wij houden van snelle en simpele sollicitatieprocedures. De motivatiebrief mag kort en bondig zijn. Een goed cv vinden wij belangrijk, zodat we ons een goed beeld kunnen vormen van de kennis, kunde en werkervaring die je meebrengt. Een assessment kan deel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Solliciteren kan via de sollicitatiebutton. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Roy Middelbos (Roy.Middelbos@uwv.nl), voor meer informatie over de sollicitatie kun je contact opnemen met teammanager Jeroen Versloot, via jeroen.versloot@uwv.nl. Motherwell. Scotland, UK.

Talented people are the key to our success.

We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Quality Advisor to join our team on a major electricity transmission framework, supporting the delivery of a range of exciting infrastructure schemes. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is keen to further develop their skills and take on increasing levels of responsibility.

Working within a high-profile transmission project environment, you will play a key role in supporting the quality management and assurance processes associated with large-scale overhead line and substation works. You will work closely with project teams and supply chain partners to ensure construction activities are delivered in line with project quality requirements, while promoting a culture of continuous improvement and compliance.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to nationally significant energy infrastructure projects while developing your career within a supportive and collaborative organisation.

Role Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of project quality management processes and procedures.
  • Monitor and oversee site activities to ensure compliance with project quality requirements, specifications, and industry standards.
  • Undertake quality inspections, audits, reviews, and surveillance activities across project sites.
  • Ensure subcontractors and delivery teams comply with quality assurance and quality control requirements.
  • Promote progressive assurance practices to identify and resolve quality issues at the earliest opportunity.
  • Review, manage, and maintain quality records and documentation, ensuring timely completion and compliance with project requirements.
  • Support the preparation, review, and close-out of inspection and test plans (ITPs), quality reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Coordinate with project, engineering, construction, and supply chain teams to drive quality performance and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in identifying quality risks and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support project handover activities by ensuring all quality documentation is complete, accurate, and auditable.

Essential

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

  • Degree-qualified in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working in a Quality Engineer, Quality Advisor, or similar quality-focused role within infrastructure, engineering, construction, or utilities projects.
  • Understanding of quality assurance and quality control processes within a project delivery environment.
  • Experience managing and reviewing quality documentation and project records.
  • Strong diligence and an initiative-taking approach to problem-solving.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with project teams, subcontractors, and clients to achieve quality objectives.

Desirable

  • Experience working on electricity transmission, overhead line (OHL), substation, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Knowledge of platforms such as Viewpoint, FieldView, or similar quality management systems.
  • Understanding of quality management systems and audit processes.
  • Experience working within major infrastructure frameworks or regulated environments.
  • Professional membership of a relevant engineering or quality institution.

What is in it for you?

Below is a selection of benefits that are available to you at Morgan Sindall Infrastructure.

  • Generous holiday entitlement with the option to buy five days.
  • Flexible and adaptable working
  • Family friendly policies and work/life approach
  • Mentoring programmes and continuous learning support
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • Recognition scheme and long service awards
  • Car scheme and Private Medical Insurance (if applicable to role)
  • We also provide the option to participate in our share-save scheme; discounts including cycle to work and gym membership; a support and advice service for colleagues and their families, and more.

About The Energy Business Unit

We have extensive experience in upgrading and replacing energy networks, delivering asset management for major UK energy companies and network operators.

Our transmission and distribution services involve the upgrading and replacement of electricity assets both above and below ground. Within the electricity sector we install and maintain assets, including excavation, laying, and jointing of cables, (fluid filled and XLPe), substations and overhead line, new build, repair, and refurbishment services.

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team where you will have the opportunity to progress in your career. We are looking for people who share our passion on delivering great customer service whilst also being able to work within an enjoyable and hardworking team environment. Talented people are the key to our success, so if this sounds like you, apply now.

Chartwells K12

Chartwells K12's goal is to make sure students leave the cafeteria happier and healthier than they came in, by serving food kids love to eat and creating custom dining programs. With more than 16,000 associates in 4,500 schools, ranging from large public institutions to small charter and private schools, Chartwells K12 is built on decades of food, education and operational experience driven by top culinary, nutrition, wellness, and sustainability talent. For more information, visit www.ChartwellsK12.com.

Job Summary

Working as a Regional Chef for Chartwells K12, you will partner with the leadership team to plan, implement, and support innovative culinary programs that positively impact the lives of countless K-12 students throughout the South Central Region, including Missouri, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Mississippi. This role is responsible for driving culinary excellence, menu innovation, operational consistency, and student engagement across the assigned territory while collaborating closely with district partners and regional teams.

The Regional Chef will provide hands-on culinary leadership, training, and support to ensure the successful execution of Chartwells K12 culinary initiatives and programs. This position requires approximately 50% travel, primarily throughout the South Central Region, with occasional travel to support other regions, attend national meetings, conferences, and company events. The ideal candidate will reside in Missouri or Arkansas; however, qualified candidates residing within any of the four states in the assigned region (Missouri, Arkansas, Louisiana, or Mississippi) will be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and inspire best in class culinary programs and standards through communication, training and assessment of execution across a region of school districts.
  • Support new business growth and retention of existing business through menu and program innovation, live presentation support and contributions to formal proposal submissions.
  • Provide onsite and remote training, coaching, and development of key culinary personnel within assigned territory.
  • Develop and mentor regional Culinary Innovation Council to ensure a continuous cycle of new product and program development.
  • Provide onsite support for new account openings and key events within the territory.
  • Orientate and on-board new chefs and culinarians
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with a diverse regional resource team including Operations, Marketing, Nutrition and Finance to achieve business goals.
  • Optimize, monitor and ensure compliance with regulatory and procurement standards, seeking opportunities for product cost or quality improvements in partnership with Purchasing and Supply Chain teams.
  • Complete all required reports, logs, and quality audits in a thorough and timely manner.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in culinary arts preferred/or equivalent professional culinary experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive culinary experience
  • Strong executive presence
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational, leadership, mentoring and training skills
  • Strategic and analytic thinker with the ability to adapt to evolving market conditions
  • Project management skills preferred
  • Strong technical skills in MS office, recipe management and nutrition systems

Provider for direct clinical supervision; Practice Manager/Administrator and/or Director of Practice Development for general supervision.

job_title: Intern (m/f/d) in the „International Initiative for the Phase-Out of SF6 in the Power Sector“
job_summary: SF6 is the most potent known greenhouse gas, yet its emissions have so far received little attention in international climate policy. They originate from gas-insulated switchgear in power infrastructure and are at risk of rising sharply as grids expand in developing and emerging economies. The project therefore supports a new international initiative on SF6 in the power sector. It analyses technologies and financing options and assesses local baseline conditions. Together with the World Bank, it pilots emission reduction measures with grid operators. These include the creation of SF6 inventories, the prevention of leaks, and the introduction of alternative technologies. The project builds a network to mobilise key stakeholders and facilitate knowledge exchange. It advises governments on integrating SF6 into national strategies, improving monitoring, reducing emissions, and phasing out SF6. Show more Show less

Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, services, and solutions for the LNG and industrial gases industry. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with over $1.5 B in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Job Overview

Responsible for installation, calibration, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of instrumentation, electrical, and control systems for skid-mounted and modular process packages executed in an EPC-style environment.

This role plays a critical part in ensuring that all field devices, control systems, and electrical installations are delivered fully functional, compliant with engineering design, and ready for startup and operation. The technician will work closely with engineering, fabrication, vendors, and commissioning teams across shop and site environments.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience in instrument calibration, loop checking, PLC-based systems, and rotating equipment packages, with a practical understanding of skid fabrication and integrated system commissioning.

Responsibilities

Instrument Installation & Calibration

  • Install, inspect, and commission field instrumentation including:
    • Pressure, temperature, flow, and level instruments
    • Control valves, actuators, and positioners
    • Analytical and specialty instrumentation (as applicable)
  • Perform instrument calibration in shop and field environments, including:
    • Transmitters, switches, gauges
    • RTDs and thermocouples
    • Flow meters (Coriolis, ultrasonic, differential pressure)
    • Level instruments (radar, DP, ultrasonic)
  • Utilize calibration and diagnostic tools such as:
    • HART communicators
    • Multifunction calibrators (e.g., Fluke)
    • Loop calibrators and signal generators
  • Maintain calibration documentation and ensure traceability to standards
Loop Checking & Functional Testing

  • Perform end-to-end loop checks from field devices to control systems (PLC/DCS/HMI)
  • Verify:
    • Signal continuity and integrity
    • Proper wiring, termination, and grounding
    • Correct scaling, ranging, and configuration
  • Execute pre-commissioning and commissioning procedures
  • Identify and resolve instrumentation and wiring issues
  • Support development and execution of loop check sheets and commissioning checklists
PLC & Controls System Support

  • Support PLC-based control systems including:
    • Verification of I/O mapping and signal integrity
    • Basic troubleshooting of PLC logic and communication issues
    • Upload/download of programs under engineering supervision
  • Work with common platforms such as:
    • Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation)
    • Siemens
    • Schneider Electric / Modicon
  • Assist with HMI/SCADA system validation and functional testing
  • Support debugging of control system issues during commissioning
Rotating Equipment & Package Integration

  • Support installation and commissioning of rotating equipment packages, including:
    • Pumps, compressors, expanders
  • Verify instrumentation and controls associated with rotating equipment:
    • Vibration monitoring systems
    • Temperature, pressure, and shutdown instrumentation
    • Package control panels and interlocks
  • Assist in startup activities, operational checks, and troubleshooting
  • Coordinate with OEM representatives such as Atlas Copco and similar vendors
Electrical Installation & Verification

  • Install and inspect:
    • Electrical panels, junction boxes, and marshalling cabinets
    • Cable trays, conduits, and field cabling
  • Perform cable pulling, termination, and continuity testing
  • Verify installations against electrical drawings and standards
Drawings, Documentation & QA/QC

  • Review and verify field installation against:
    • P&IDs
    • Loop diagrams
    • Wiring diagrams
    • Cable schedules and I/O lists
  • Mark up redlines and support development of as-built documentation
  • Perform field inspections, punch listing, and close-out activities
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • NEC
    • IEC
    • ISA standards
    • Project and client specifications
Commissioning, FAT & SAT Support

  • Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)
  • Execute commissioning procedures and assist in system startup
  • Troubleshoot instrumentation, electrical, and control issues during commissioning
  • Support handover to operations teams

Coordination & Field Interface

  • Coordinate with:
    • Process, Mechanical, and I&C Engineering teams
    • Fabrication shops and skid manufacturers
    • Construction and commissioning teams
    • Third-party inspectors and vendors
  • Provide field feedback to engineering for design improvements
  • Support resolution of technical issues during fabrication and site execution
Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in oil & gas, LNG, industrial gas, or process industries
  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, instrumentation, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Instrument calibration (shop and field)
    • Loop checking and commissioning
    • Electrical wiring, termination, and testing
    • PLC-based control systems (troubleshooting level)
  • Experience working with skid-mounted systems and modular process packages
  • Experience supporting rotating equipment systems strongly preferred
  • Ability to read and interpret:
    • P&IDs
    • Loop diagrams
    • Wiring diagrams
    • Electrical drawings
  • Familiarity with EPC project workflows and field execution practices
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with major OEM equipment packages and controls
  • Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities
  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, Ethernet/IP)

Desired Attributes

  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic capability
  • Hands-on, execution-focused mindset
  • High attention to detail and documentation discipline
  • Ability to work independently in field and shop environments
  • Strong communication and coordination skills across engineering and field teams

The knowledge, skills and abilities listed above are typically acquired through the levels of education and experience listed. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience that provides an applicant with the listed knowledge, skills and abilities required to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job, may be accepted.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Employee may be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects, tools, or controls
  • Overtime may be necessary as the workload dictates. This may include weekdays, weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. may be required

Improve the health and well-being of communities

Careers in public health

Public health careers focus on preventing disease, promoting healthy habits and shaping health policies to keep everyone safe and well.

Whether you want to become a doctor, nurse, or lawyer, create impactful health programs, or advocate for better health policies, public health offers endless ways to do meaningful work that improves lives and strengthens communities.

Image

Values and interests

If the following values and interests resonate, a career in public health could be a great fit.

Values

  • Community engagement
  • Continuous learning
  • Environmental responsibility
  • Health equity
  • Helping others
  • Social justice
  • Supporting underserved communities
  • Sustainability

Interests

  • Access to healthcare
  • Advocating for health policy changes
  • Effects of climate change on human health
  • Global health challenges
  • Health administration
  • Health promotion
  • Improving systems for public health
  • Managing chronic disease
  • Occupational impacts on health
  • Preventive healthcare
  • Preventing and managing disease outbreaks
  • Healthcare careers

What can you do with a public health degree?

Public health prepares you for careers in medicine, law, research and community health. Many graduates go on to medical, nursing, or physician assistant school, while others pursue law degrees in health policy and advocacy.

If you’re drawn to data and research, you might become an epidemiologist, biostatistician or environmental health analyst. Others work in health education, policy, or public health program management, creating initiatives that improve community well-being.

No matter the path, public health graduates make a lasting impact on people’s lives.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator / Patching Coordinator to support the coordination and management of server patching and security remediation activity across a large technology environment.


This is not a hands-on technical Systems Administrator role. The successful candidate will have a good general understanding of Windows and Linux environments, combined with strong coordination, communication and organisational skills.


The role will involve working closely with technical teams, particularly Applied Information Technology (AIT), to understand patching and software deployment requirements, coordinate activity across servers, and ensure required fixes and packages are scheduled and delivered appropriately.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate server patching activity across Windows and Linux environments.
  • Manage and schedule servers for patching and security remediation.
  • Coordinate the deployment of required fixes, patches and software packages.
  • Work with AIT and other technical teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Translate technical requirements into clear and actionable patching activities.
  • Ensure required packages are prepared and scheduled for deployment.
  • Monitor and coordinate remediation of server-related security vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain awareness of server patching status and outstanding remediation activity.
  • Support security reporting relating to servers and patching.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records and provide clear written updates on patching activity.
  • Coordinate activity across large server estates and ensure work is completed within agreed timescales.


Technical Environment

The candidate should have a general understanding of:

  • Windows Server
  • Linux
  • Unix/Solaris environments
  • Server patching and vulnerability remediation
  • Software/package deployment
  • Server scheduling and maintenance
  • Security and vulnerability reporting
  • Patching automation and associated processes


Expert-level technical knowledge is not required. The key requirement is an understanding of how Windows and Linux server environments operate and how patches, fixes and packages are coordinated and deployed.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in a Systems Administration, Systems Analysis, Patching or Infrastructure coordination environment.
  • Experience working with large numbers of servers or a large-scale infrastructure estate.
  • Understanding of Windows and Linux environments.
  • Experience coordinating patching, fixes or software/package deployments.
  • Understanding of server-related security vulnerabilities and remediation.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Ability to understand and interpret requests from technical teams.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple activities and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working across technical teams without necessarily being the hands-on technical expert.


Ideal Background

Candidates may come from backgrounds such as:

  • Systems Administrator
  • Systems Analyst
  • Infrastructure Analyst
  • Patching Coordinator
  • Infrastructure Coordinator
  • Server Administrator
  • IT Operations Analyst
  • Vulnerability/Remediation Analyst


Candidates with experience supporting large server estates would be particularly relevant.


Role Focus

The key distinction is that this role is primarily focused on coordination, scheduling, communication and remediation management, rather than hands-on server administration.

Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and optimize robust backend APIs and web services.

  • Assist in the integration of AI-driven features into the core platform.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to debug technical issues and improve overall system performance and reliability.
  • Participate actively in code reviews and support the continuous improvement of the product’s codebase and automation workflows.
  • Contribute to documentation for internal tools and services.


Qualifications & Skills

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

The Value Stream Solution Architect is a senior, client‑facing market specialist with a deep understanding of SimCorp’s target industries, their end‑to‑end value chain, and key pain points. The role is accountable for shaping, governing, and driving adoption of SimCorp One (SC One) Standards across the full Front‑to‑Back (F2B) investment lifecycle—assertively guiding clients toward standard‑first, upgradeable, and evergreen outcomes spanning Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Data, and Reporting. Partnering with Sales and delivery leadership, the architect owns end‑to‑end Solutioning, leads Fit‑to‑Standard workshops, articulates trade‑offs (scope, timeline, run costs), and ensures customization is introduced only when truly justified. They maintain overall solution integrity by integrating domain designs into a coherent architecture that embeds service‑management processes, tooling, compliance, security, and operational readiness from day one—while feeding recurring gaps and integration pain points back into Standards Governance and Product Management to continuously strengthen the SimCorp One standard.

Core Responsibilities

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  • Definition of the SimCorp One Standards: Drive the end‑to‑end definition and integrity of SC One Standards, ensuring consistency across the Standard Scope Document and all governing internal assets (single source of truth). Lead executive‑level standards positioning (in‑standard vs. exceptions) and govern variances via fit assessments, variance logs, and escalation through agreed Standards governance.
  • Project scoping & Fit‑to‑Standard: Be accountable for the overall end-to-end solution for clients (across Standard and Custom). Act as the primary sparring partner to Commercial; support the delta assessment and drive disciplined, standards‑led scoping with management‑level client stakeholders. Oversee Fit‑to‑Standard workshops and steer decisions toward standard‑first end‑to‑end outcomes, clearly articulating trade‑offs and commercial implications (scope, timeline, and run costs).
  • Design services‑enabled solutions: Design services‑enabled solutions aligned to client outcomes while protecting standard integrity and upgradeability across the end to end solution ,ensure service‑management processes, tooling, compliance, and security are embedded in design and delivery guardrails.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders: Translate client and internal business requirements into standardized business processes and measurable end‑to‑end outcomes; partner with other Architects, Standards Guilds, and Client Operations to embed standards and approved variances into Compass delivery plans, acceptance criteria, and BAU transition.
  • Leadership and governance: Provide senior leadership across Product/Delivery and Value Streams to drive solution strategy, roadmap input, and the operating model required to scale standards‑based delivery. Act as the bridge between standards governance and execution, ensuring client feedback is converted into actionable standards improvements with clear decisions to closure.
  • Protect solution integrity during delivery: Coordinate across value‑stream and consulting teams, run design governance forums, and intervene when cross‑domain conflicts or custom extensions threaten upgradeability or operability.
  • Embed service readiness into the architecture: Ensure operational processes, support model, SaaS constraints, security and controls are built into the solution so it is sustainable in Run, not just functional at go‑live.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the standard: Capture recurring gaps and integration pain points from implementations and feed them into Standards Governance and Product Management for systematic remediation.

Technical Responsibilities

  • Design service‑enabled end‑to‑end solutions that account for operational processes, SaaS constraints, and security, ensuring the delivered solution is not only functional but also supportable and upgradeable as a whole.
  • Oversee release and quality enablement through the release pipeline, ensuring architecture decisions and scope are compatible with the standardized release process, integrated test framework, and quality gates required to keep the solution upgradeable.
  • Lead delivery architecture oversight, coordinating across value teams and consulting teams, running design governance meetings, and intervening when cross‑domain conflicts or proposed custom extensions jeopardize alignment or upgradeability.
  • Operate in Azure DevOps as the system of record for delivery, maintaining architectural epics/features, linking decisions/variances to backlog items, and aligning cross‑team work to the agreed end‑to‑end architecture and standards outcomes.

Ways of Working

  • Coordinate with the Value Stream Management Office (VMO) to ensure that solution architecture aligns with standard governance processes and ways of working.

What We Value

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in solution architecture / enterprise architecture / senior implementation architecture, owning cross‑domain (front‑to‑back) designs in complex enterprise platforms.
  • Prior client‑facing experience in business consulting and/or SME roles, leading front‑to‑back solution discussions and executive stakeholder alignment in complex asset management environments.

  • Working knowledge of SaaS delivery constraints and operating models, and comfort using Azure DevOps to manage and trace architectural scope (epics/features) and decisions to delivery outcomes.

job_summary: Brand Strategy Manager Location: Fergus Falls, Minnesota Salary Grade: 15 Help Strengthen How a Trusted Organization Is Understood. For more than a century, Otter Tail Power has built its reputation by delivering safe, reliable, and cost-effective energy while supporting the communities we serve. As our business, stakeholders, and operating environment become increasingly complex, we're continuing to strengthen how we align our brand, communications, and stakeholder understanding with our long-term strategy. We're looking for an experienced leader to guide that work. As our Brand Strategy Leader, you'll lead the team responsible for how business priorities are translated into enterprise narrative, communication strategy, content, creative services, editorial planning, research, insights, and production. You'll help ensure our employees, customers, communities, and stakeholders experience one clear, consistent, and credible company story. This is not a traditional communications management role. This is an opportunity to shape the systems, standards, and strategies that support how a trusted utility is understood by the people who matter most. This position reports to Director Communications. What You'll Do Lead enterprise brand strategy and communication planning. Establish and steward the company's narrative, message architecture, and brand standards. Serve as a strategic advisor to leaders across the company on communication strategy and stakeholder understanding. Direct editorial planning, governance, workflow, and communication resource prioritization. Lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for content strategy, writing, design, editorial planning, communication operations, research and insights, and production. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, public relations, journalism, design, business, or a related field. Progressive experience in brand strategy, communications, marketing, creative services, content strategy, editorial management, communication planning, reputation research, or a related discipline. Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into clear brand, messaging, content, editorial, creative, and communication plans. Experience leading communication planning, content strategy, creative services, editorial workflows, production operations, or cross-functional communication initiatives. Strong understanding of brand governance, message architecture, editorial planning, visual identity, content strategy, audience needs, channel coordination, and communication measurement. Ability to evaluate and prioritize work based on strategic value, business impact, stakeholder needs, resource availability, and timing. Strong writing, editing, presentation, consultation, planning, and strategic communication skills. Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and business partners toward effective communication solutions without relying on positional authority. Experience developing outcome-focused metrics and using research, performance data, and insights to improve communication effectiveness. Ability to lead experienced contributors, manage competing priorities, and improve systems, processes, workflows, and overall team effectiveness. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in a regulated industry, utility, energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, or another complex business environment. Experience overseeing creative, editorial, production, print, or communication operations. Experience with AI governance, content automation, reputation measurement, brand research, media monitoring, or stakeholder insights. The Role

We're looking for a Solution Architect to join our growing Solution Architecture team and lead the end-to-end solution design for one of our strategic missions in the Airline Operations domain. This is a pivotal role where you will shape how multiple product teams come together to deliver a coherent, scalable, and high-value solution.


You’ll work at the intersection of architecture, delivery, and product, providing solution direction, setting guardrails, and ensuring technical integrity while enabling teams to move fast and deliver impactful outcomes

Your responsibilities:


  • Provide architecture leadership for a product mission team, defining mission-level solution architecture and creating a clear architecture vision for product teams to align with.
  • Shape the end-to-end solution across multiple product teams, platforms and technology domains, ensuring consistency and alignment.
  • Establish solution guardrails, principles, reference architectures and patterns, identifying opportunities for reuse and optimisation, promoting architecture best practices.
  • Partner with Product Leads, Tech Leads and Delivery Leads to ensure cohesive solution design and delivery.
  • Align solutions with long-term enterprise strategy, architecture principles and standards.
  • Identify and resolve cross-team solution dependencies and integration risks early.
  • Communicate architecture and solution decisions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Coach teams on architectural thinking, reusable patterns and design approaches.

Defining & owning end-to-end solution architecture

  • Define the mission level architecture vision, scope and evolution roadmap, ensuring the solution meets mission outcomes, customer needs, and business objectives.
  • Design cross-team integrations, shared components, and data flows, identifying and resolving solution risks, dependencies, and architectural gaps early.
  • Provide clear solution architecture direction to Tech Leads, Product Leads, and Delivery Leads.
  • Communicate solution decisions, trade-offs, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Assuring design alignment & solution delivery

  • Lead architecture governance activities to ensure solution assurance and compliance.
  • Align solutions with enterprise strategy, architecture principles and standards, collaborating with IT Architecture team on architectural reviews, exceptions and guidance.
  • Define solution guardrails, principles, reference architectures and patterns, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and operability.
  • Align multiple products to shared design principles, patterns, and integration contracts, ensuring product-level designs fit into a cohesive mission-level architecture.

Continuous Architecture Practice Improvement

  • Contribute to shaping and maturing the solution architecture practice.
  • Champion architecture best practice, including safety/security by design, operational excellence, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimisation, and sustainability.

Your Profile

  • Lead SA who can handle large programs with good stakeholder management skills With at least 6 to 8 years’ experience in solution architecture space
  • a strong solution architecture background, particularly in domain-driven design and event-driven architecture
  • strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • experience working in mission/product delivery environment
  • ideally exposure to airline operations, especially crew pairing and roster optimiser is desirable

  • Demonstrable experience in leading end-to-end solutions spanning multiple teams or domains, ensuring that they meet business outcomes.
  • Proven ability to work in agile, product-based or mission-led organisations product way of working
  • Strong understanding of modern architecture (cloud native – AWS preferred, microservices, APIs, events, canonical data models).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence architecture on a scale, from engineers to business leaders, by explaining technical solutions in clear, business-relevant terms.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills, able to assess trade-offs between time, cost and technical debts.
  • Good understanding of strategic and emerging technology trends, and the practical application to evolving business models.
  • Experience in coaching and developing technical teams on architecture thinking.

Desirable skills/knowledge/experience:

  • Design certification – TOGAF
  • Familiarity with airline or transport operations systems (crew, flight planning, disruption, scheduling) is highly desirable.
  • Strong command in transforming business requirements into IT solutions

Exciting Opportunity: Family Services Specialist

Join our team as a Family Services Specialist! Under the dynamic leadership of our center manager, you'll spearhead family partnership activities, fostering collaborative community ties. Your pivotal role ensures the success of our agency and Head Start program, supporting families and enhancing children's school readiness. Be a catalyst for positive change!

Responsibilities

  • Manage all aspects of the family partnerships area for the center in accordance with the Head Start Act, Head Start Performance Standards, and best practices in family services.

  • Enhance parent-child relationships and support parents’ role as the first and lifelong educators of their children. Work with teachers to assist parents and families to observe, guide, promote, and participate in the everyday learning of children at home, school, and in their communities.

About Us

At Centro de la Familia, we are not just educators; we are dream builders. Our warm, vibrant environment is designed to cultivate curious minds, explore boundless possibilities, and create lasting memories. We believe that every child is a unique story waiting to be written.

Requirements

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in social work or a related field is strongly preferred. At a minimum, the applicant must be willing to obtain a Family Development Credential within 12 months of hire. We are passionate about our work and the incredible children and families we have the privilege to support.
